66447.recognize_zh: 視野中有多個中性球（neutrophil）被一圈紅血球緊密環繞、呈花瓣狀排列（neutrophil-erythrocyte rosette），背景可見少數小而緻密、缺乏中央淡染區的紅血球，提示自體免疫溶血性貧血（AIHA）。
features: Several segmented neutrophils each encircled by a single ring of closely apposed red cells, forming flower-like rosettes
Red cells in the rosettes are radially arranged and slightly deformed where they abut the neutrophil membrane
Neutrophils show normal lobation and granulation without visible ingested red cells (no erythrophagocytosis in this field)
Occasional small dense red cells lacking central pallor (spherocyte-like) and a rare polychromatic cell in the background
Scattered normal-sized platelets; no red cell agglutination clumps or schistocytes evident
66447.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows multiple neutrophils each surrounded by a ring of adherent erythrocytes, forming neutrophil-erythrocyte rosettes. The rosetting neutrophils are morphologically unremarkable, and no definite erythrophagocytosis is seen in this field. The background red cells include occasional small dense spherocyte-like forms and a rare polychromatic cell; no large agglutinates or schistocytes are identified. Findings are suggestive of antibody-mediated red cell coating, as seen in autoimmune hemolytic anemia; correlation with DAT and hemolysis markers is recommended.

ddx.vs: Agglutination forms irregular free-floating red cell clumps without a central leukocyte, whereas rosettes are an organized ring of red cells around a neutrophil.
Erythrophagocytosis shows red cells or pale vacuoles inside the neutrophil cytoplasm, while rosetting red cells remain external and adherent to the cell surface.
Satellitism is an EDTA artifact of platelets, not red cells, ringing neutrophils.
Rouleaux are linear stacked red cells like coins without a central leukocyte, typically with a bluish proteinaceous background.

65935.recognize_zh: 中央嗜中性球的核分成六葉以上的小圓葉，並有一個小而圓、獨立的核附屬體，可相容於 Barr body（drumstick）；周圍紅血球大小正常、無大卵圓紅血球，符合非巨芽球性原因造成的分葉過多嗜中性球。
features: Neutrophil of normal size with a nucleus divided into six or more small rounded lobes
A small, round, dense nuclear appendage compatible with a drumstick (Barr body)
Cytoplasm with fine neutrophilic granules without toxic granulation or vacuoles
Interlobar filaments are not all clearly visible due to lobe overlap
Normocytic red cells with occasional irregular or fragmented forms; no macro-ovalocytes
Scattered normal platelets
65935.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic, normochromic red cells with occasional irregularly shaped forms and no macro-ovalocytes. A neutrophil of normal size shows a hypersegmented nucleus with six or more small rounded lobes, some overlapping, and a small round nuclear appendage compatible with a drumstick (Barr body). The cytoplasm contains normal fine granules without toxic changes. Findings are consistent with a hypersegmented neutrophil; in the absence of macrocytosis, correlation with vitamin B12 and folate levels, renal function, and medication history is recommended.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic anemia shows hypersegmentation accompanied by macro-ovalocytes and often pancytopenia, with low B12 or folate levels.
Drug-induced hypersegmentation is morphologically identical and is separated by medication history, often with macrocytosis.
Apoptotic neutrophils show separate, smooth, dense, pyknotic nuclear spheres without connecting filaments and a condensed cytoplasm.
Macropolycytes are roughly twice normal size with a large multilobed nucleus, whereas this neutrophil is normal in size.

65807.recognize_zh: 上排是高核質比、胞質稀少的淋巴母細胞，流式為 CD34+CD19+ 且 cyCD79a+TdT+；下排細胞變大、胞質較多呈單核球樣，流式轉為 CD19-CD34-、CD14+CD64+，全基因組拷貝數也新增多處變化，表示由 B-ALL 轉為單核球性 AML。
features: Initial blood: medium-sized blasts with high N:C ratio, scant basophilic cytoplasm and fine chromatin (lymphoblast-like)
Initial flow: 94.6% CD45-dim events, CD34+/CD19+ (84.6%) and cytoplasmic CD79a+/TdT+ (93.7%)
At switch: larger blasts with more abundant grey-blue cytoplasm and folded monocytoid nuclei
Switch flow: monocyte gate expanded to 57.8%, CD19-negative/CD34-negative, and 98.2% CD14+/CD64+
Whole-genome copy-number plot: flat baseline in B-ALL; gains of 1q, 4q, 8q and 11q and loss of 14q at AML
65807.describe_en: Initial peripheral blood smear shows medium-sized blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio and scant cytoplasm; flow cytometry demonstrates a CD45-dim population expressing CD34, CD19, cytoplasmic CD79a and TdT, consistent with B-lymphoblastic leukemia. The later smear shows larger blasts and monocytoid cells with more abundant cytoplasm and folded nuclei, and flow cytometry now shows a predominant CD14+/CD64+ monocytic population that has lost CD19 and CD34. Whole-genome copy-number profiles show no alterations at baseline but new gains of 1q, 4q, 8q and 11q and loss of 14q at transformation. Findings are consistent with lineage switch of KMT2A-rearranged B-ALL to acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation.

ddx.vs: MPAL shows B and myeloid/monocytic populations at the same time point, whereas here the phenotypes are sequential with complete loss of B-lineage markers.
Antigen-escape relapse retains other B markers (CD22, cytoplasmic CD79a, PAX5) and lymphoblast morphology, not CD14+/CD64+ monocytic cells.

ddx.dx: Therapy-related AML unrelated to the original clone
ddx.vs: A new t-AML would not share the original AFF1::KMT2A fusion and KRAS mutation shown by WGS.
Recovery monocytes are mature, CD45-bright and not accompanied by marked leukocytosis, blasts or new clonal copy-number changes.

65807.stain: Wright-Giemsa; flow cytometry; WGS copy number

65679.recognize_zh: 玻璃體液抹片中散在比周圍小淋巴球大好幾倍的大型異型細胞，核圓、染色質細、細胞質嗜鹼性，常成小群；右上一片長形深染核排列整齊並帶纖維狀物的是脫落的視網膜細胞，左上可見黑綠色色素顆粒，勿誤認為腫瘤。
features: Scattered large atypical lymphoid cells, several times the size of small lymphocytes, singly and in small clusters
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with fine chromatin and deep basophilic cytoplasm; occasional binucleate forms
Sheet of detached retinal cells with small elongated dark nuclei aligned along pink-violet fibrillary material
Dark green-brown pigment granules consistent with retinal pigment epithelium-derived melanin
Scattered small lymphocytes, red cells, and cellular debris in background
65679.describe_en: Vitreous fluid cytospin shows a paucicellular background with scattered red cells, small lymphocytes, and debris. There are numerous large atypical lymphoid cells, singly and in small clusters, with round to irregular nuclei, fine chromatin, and moderate deeply basophilic cytoplasm, some binucleate. Separately, a cohesive fragment of detached retinal cells with small uniform elongated dark nuclei and fibrillary material and clumps of green-brown pigment are present and should not be mistaken for tumor. Findings are suggestive of involvement by large B-cell lymphoma (vitreoretinal lymphoma), to be confirmed by flow cytometry, IL-10/IL-6 ratio, or MYD88 L265P testing given the fragility of these cells.

ddx.vs: Retinal cells are small, uniform, and cohesive with elongated dark nuclei and fibrillary outer segments, unlike the large discohesive atypical lymphoid cells.

ddx.dx: Uveitis with reactive lymphocytes and macrophages
ddx.vs: Inflammatory vitreous shows small mature lymphocytes and foamy macrophages without large atypical cells, and a low IL-10/IL-6 ratio.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or melanoma to the vitreous
ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells form cohesive epithelial groups and melanoma cells contain intrinsic melanin and are S100/SOX10-positive, whereas lymphoma is CD20-positive and discohesive.
Macrophages have abundant vacuolated cytoplasm with phagocytosed pigment and bland reniform nuclei.

65423.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片滿布大型芽細胞，細胞質灰藍帶小空泡，其中幾顆芽細胞的空泡內含被吞噬的紅血球（黃色箭頭），就是芽細胞噬紅血球現象（erythrophagocytosis），常見於 KAT6A 易位的單核球性 AML。
features: Sheets of large blasts with round to oval, slightly irregular nuclei, fine chromatin and one or more visible nucleoli
Moderate to abundant blue-gray cytoplasm with scattered small clear vacuoles
Engulfed intact or partially digested red blood cells within cytoplasmic vacuoles of blasts (yellow arrows)
Markedly reduced residual erythroid and granulocytic precursors
No Auer rods identified in the fields shown
65423.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows sheets of large blasts with fine chromatin, visible nucleoli, slightly irregular nuclear contours, and moderate blue-gray cytoplasm with small clear vacuoles. Several blasts contain phagocytic vacuoles with engulfed red blood cells, consistent with erythrophagocytosis by leukemic cells. Residual normal hematopoiesis is markedly reduced, and Auer rods are not seen. With an MPO-positive, CD34/CD117-negative blast phenotype with monocytic markers and t(8;22)(p11;q13), findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation and KAT6A::EP300 rearrangement.

ddx.vs: Morphology (monocytic blasts with erythrophagocytosis) is shared, so the KAT6A partner (CREBBP vs EP300) is defined only by cytogenetics or molecular testing.
HLH shows mature histiocytes with bland, low N:C nuclei engulfing blood cells amid normal hematopoiesis, not sheets of nucleolated blasts.
Other monocytic AML subtypes have similar blasts but lack prominent phagocytosis and the KAT6A rearrangement.
Metastatic cells form cohesive clusters and are cytokeratin or other lineage marker-positive rather than MPO/CD33-positive discohesive blasts.

65167.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中小圓形腫瘤細胞核深染、細胞質極少，聚成一團並拖出細長纖維狀突起，類似神經纖維（neuropil）；這種成團的小圓藍細胞加上纖維狀尾巴是神經母細胞瘤轉移的線索。
features: Small to medium round cells with high N:C ratio and dense, darkly staining nuclei
Loosely cohesive cluster with nuclear crowding and molding
Thin, elongated fibrillary cytoplasmic process extending from the cluster (neuritic/neuropil-like)
Scant cytoplasm; nucleoli not discernible at this staining quality
Background of red cells and smudged/disrupted cells; stain is faded and magenta-toned, limiting nuclear detail
65167.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows numerous small to medium round cells with high N:C ratio and dense nuclei, including a loosely cohesive cluster with nuclear crowding. A thin fibrillary process extends from the cluster, suggestive of neuritic or neuropil-like material. Many cells are disrupted, and the faded magenta staining limits assessment of chromatin and nucleoli. Normal hematopoietic elements are difficult to identify in this field. In correlation with the CD45-negative, CD56-positive flow cytometric population, findings are consistent with bone marrow infiltration by metastatic neuroblastoma.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts are discohesive single cells without clusters or fibrillary processes and are CD45/CD19 or CD3 positive with TdT.
Ewing sarcoma cells also form small round cell clusters but lack neuropil and show vacuolated PAS-positive cytoplasm with CD99 and EWSR1 rearrangement.
Rhabdomyosarcoma cells often have more cytoplasm, multinucleated forms and vacuoles, and are desmin/myogenin positive rather than PHOX2B/synaptophysin positive.
Platelet clumps are anucleate granular aggregates, whereas this cluster consists of intact nucleated cells.

65231.recognize_zh: 目鏡拍攝的高細胞密度抹片，布滿大小不一的單核細胞，細胞質灰藍，核圓或分葉、染色質細而開放，部分細胞很大、似漿母細胞（plasmablastic）；但此圖看不到典型核偏位與核旁淡染區，須配合 CD38/CD138/kappa 表現才能確認為漿細胞白血病。
features: Densely cellular field of monotonous atypical mononuclear cells with varying size, including very large forms
Moderate grey-blue cytoplasm; eccentric nuclei and perinuclear hof not consistently discernible
Round to lobulated or indented nuclei with finely dispersed, open chromatin
Occasional binucleate or multilobated cells and a possible mitotic figure
Numerous small refractile clear droplets and larger clear spaces in the background (likely artifact)
Few red cells; photographed through the eyepiece with limited resolution
65231.describe_en: Photomicrograph taken through the eyepiece shows a densely cellular smear dominated by atypical mononuclear cells with few intervening red cells. The cells vary from medium to very large, with moderate grey-blue cytoplasm and round, indented or lobulated nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin, giving an immature, plasmablastic appearance; classic plasma cell features such as eccentric nuclei with clockface chromatin and a perinuclear hof are not reliably seen. Background refractile droplets are likely artifactual. Morphology alone is nonspecific at this resolution, but with the reported CD38+/CD138+ kappa-restricted phenotype the findings support plasma cell leukemia secondary to myeloma.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Monoblasts/promonocytes also have folded nuclei and grey-blue cytoplasm but are CD38/CD138-negative and express CD33, CD64, CD14 or lysozyme.
ATLL flower cells have multilobated nuclei with condensed chromatin and a CD4+/CD25+ T-cell phenotype with HTLV-1 serology.
Plasmablastic lymphoma shares the CD138+ phenotype but typically lacks a myeloma history, is often EBER-positive, and presents as an extramedullary mass.

65103.recognize_zh: 淋巴結 H&E 20 倍：中央是一個萎縮並玻璃樣變的生發中心，周圍細胞呈同心圓排列，其中及周邊夾雜染色質呈泡狀、核仁明顯的大型細胞（plasmablasts），外圍為成熟淋巴球與漿細胞，符合 HHV8 相關多中心 Castleman 病的背景。
features: Regressed follicle with a hyalinized, eosinophilic center and concentrically arranged surrounding cells
Scattered large cells with vesicular chromatin, prominent nucleoli and amphophilic cytoplasm within and around the follicle
Surrounding small mature lymphocytes forming an ill-defined mantle
Interfollicular plasma cells and occasional vessels with hyaline material
No sheets of atypical large cells effacing architecture
65103.describe_en: Lymph node section (H&E, 20x) shows a regressed germinal center with central hyalinization and concentric layering of cells, surrounded by a poorly delineated rim of small lymphocytes. Scattered large plasmacytoid cells with vesicular chromatin, prominent nucleoli and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm are present within the follicle and its periphery. The interfollicular region contains small lymphocytes and plasma cells without sheet-like proliferation of large cells. Findings are consistent with HHV8-associated multicentric Castleman disease with plasmablasts; confirmation requires LANA-1 (HHV8) immunohistochemistry.

ddx.dx: Idiopathic multicentric Castleman disease / hyaline vascular Castleman disease
ddx.vs: These show regressed follicles but lack HHV8 LANA-1-positive plasmablasts, which are required for HHV8-associated MCD.

ddx.dx: HHV8-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS
ddx.vs: HHV8+ DLBCL forms confluent sheets of LANA-1-positive plasmablasts effacing the node, rather than small clusters within the mantle and follicles.
Reactive nodes have enlarged active germinal centers with tingible body macrophages, not hyalinized regressed follicles, and immunoblasts are HHV8-negative and polytypic.

65039.recognize_zh: 中倍下淋巴結實質被大量擴張的淋巴管腔分隔，腔內為淡粉紅色蛋白質性淋巴液並散有少量淋巴球；殘存淋巴組織呈條索狀圍繞小血管，形成網狀、海綿狀外觀，符合淋巴管擴張。
features: Numerous dilated, variably sized lymphatic channels throughout the nodal parenchyma
Channels filled with pale eosinophilic proteinaceous lymph containing scattered lymphocytes
Residual lymphoid tissue compressed into cords and perivascular cuffs around small vessels
Thin, bland endothelial lining without atypia
No spindle cell proliferation, hemorrhage-filled channels or granulomas
65039.describe_en: Lymph node section at intermediate power shows the parenchyma extensively divided by numerous dilated lymphatic channels filled with pale eosinophilic lymph and scattered lymphocytes. The residual lymphoid tissue is compressed into cords and cuffs around small vessels, giving a sieve-like appearance. The channels are lined by thin, bland endothelium, and there is no atypical spindle cell proliferation. The lymph appears lightly proteinaceous rather than completely clear in this section. Findings are consistent with nodal lymphangiectasia with diffuse dilatation of lymphatic sinuses.

ddx.vs: In vascular transformation the sinuses are converted to anastomosing capillary-like channels filled with red cells and accompanied by sclerosis, unlike these lymph-filled spaces.
Lymphangioma forms a mass-like proliferation of lymphatic spaces with muscular walls, often extranodal, whereas this is dilatation of native nodal sinuses.

Those show empty lipid vacuoles of varying size with foamy histiocytes and giant cells (PAS-positive macrophages in Whipple disease), rather than endothelium-lined channels containing proteinaceous lymph.

64975.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀圖而非形態圖：在 FSC/SSC 閘門 R1 內，CD38 陽性約 90%、CD56 陽性約 83%、CD138 陽性約 81%，CD38/CD56 雙參數圖大部分落在右上雙陽性象限，表示異常漿細胞群共同表現 CD38、CD138 與異常的 CD56。
features: FSC vs SSC plot with gate R1 capturing about 71% of events as a low-SSC population
CD38-FITC histogram: about 90% positive with bright expression
CD56-PE histogram: about 83% positive with a single bright peak
CD138-FITC histogram: about 81% positive
CD38 vs CD56 quadrant plot: the dominant population lies in the CD38+/CD56+ quadrant
No CD45, CD19 or kappa/lambda light-chain plots are shown
64975.describe_en: Flow cytometric plots show a gated population (R1, about 71% of events) on forward versus side scatter. Within the gate, the cells are brightly positive for CD38 (about 90%) and CD138 (about 81%), and the majority co-express CD56 (about 83%), as shown by the dominant CD38+/CD56+ cluster on the quadrant plot. CD56 expression is aberrant for plasma cells, which normally are CD56-negative. Because CD19, CD45 and cytoplasmic light-chain data are not shown, clonality cannot be established from this figure alone; the findings are suggestive of a neoplastic plasma cell population in plasma cell dyscrasia.

ddx.vs: Normal plasma cells are CD19+, CD45+, CD56- and polytypic for kappa and lambda, rather than CD56-positive with restriction.
PBL can share CD38/CD138 expression but is often CD56-variable, EBER-positive and presents as an aggressive extramedullary mass with high Ki-67.
NK cells are CD56+ but CD138-negative and express CD2, CD7 and cytoplasmic CD3ε rather than bright CD38/CD138.

64271.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 CD71 免疫染色中，脂肪細胞之間密集排列、圓核的大量不成熟細胞呈瀰漫性細胞膜與細胞質棕色陽性，僅少數細胞（如巨核細胞、部分骨髓系細胞）陰性，顯示整片浸潤屬紅血球系，支持純紅血球白血病。
features: Hypercellular marrow with sheets of round mononuclear cells between adipocytes
Diffuse strong membranous and granular cytoplasmic CD71 (transferrin receptor) positivity in the majority of cells
Occasional cells with more intense ring-like membranous staining
Scattered negative cells with blue nuclei, including a small cluster and larger cells (likely megakaryocytes or myeloid/stromal cells)
Staining distribution similar to E-cadherin per record
64271.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD71 on the bone marrow trephine biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow in which sheets of immature round cells are diffusely and strongly positive with membranous and cytoplasmic staining, while only scattered residual cells are negative. The distribution parallels E-cadherin staining. These findings indicate that the predominant infiltrate is of erythroid lineage and, in conjunction with the aspirate morphology showing sheets of proerythroblast-like blasts, support pure erythroid leukemia; note that CD71 is not specific for neoplasia and is also expressed by reactive erythroid hyperplasia.

ddx.dx: Reactive erythroid hyperplasia (e.g., hemolysis, megaloblastic anemia recovery)
ddx.vs: Reactive erythropoiesis is CD71-positive but shows full maturation with hemoglobinized normoblasts, is p53-negative/weak, and lacks sheets of immature proerythroblasts.
Megakaryoblasts are CD61/CD42b positive and E-cadherin/CD71 negative or weak.

ddx.dx: AML with myeloblasts or myelodysplastic neoplasm with erythroid predominance
ddx.vs: Myeloblast-rich AML is CD34/MPO positive, and erythroid-predominant MDS has less than 30% proerythroblasts with retained maturation.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor
ddx.vs: Solid tumors are negative for CD71/E-cadherin in this pattern and express lineage markers such as cytokeratin, synaptophysin or CD99.

64719.recognize_zh: 皮膚真皮內瀰漫的中大型母細胞，核形明顯不規則（摺疊、拉長、腎形），染色質細、核仁不明顯，細胞質淡而空，間質少量粉紅膠原，無明顯發炎或壞死，形態上屬非特異性母細胞浸潤，符合 BPDCN 皮膚病灶。
features: Dense diffuse infiltrate of medium-to-large blastoid cells dissecting between collagen
Pleomorphic, irregular nuclei with folded, elongated, and kidney-shaped contours
Fine chromatin and small or inconspicuous nucleoli
Scant-to-moderate pale, finely vacuolated agranular cytoplasm
Scant intervening eosinophilic dermal collagen; no necrosis, angiocentricity, or eosinophils
64719.describe_en: High-power H&E section of a skin biopsy shows the dermis replaced by a diffuse infiltrate of medium-to-large blastoid cells separated by scant eosinophilic collagen. Nuclei are irregular and frequently folded or elongated, with fine chromatin and small nucleoli, and the cytoplasm is pale and agranular. There is no necrosis, angiodestruction, or significant mixed inflammatory infiltrate. The morphology alone is nonspecific, but with a CD4+/CD56+/CD123+/TCF4+ immunophenotype lacking myeloid and lymphoid lineage markers, findings are consistent with cutaneous involvement by blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia cutis with monocytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Monocytic leukemia cutis shows lysozyme, CD14/CD163 and often MPO expression, whereas BPDCN is MPO/lysozyme negative with strong CD123, TCF4 and TCL1.
PTCL usually includes a mixed inflammatory background and expresses surface CD3 with clonal TCR rearrangement, whereas BPDCN lacks CD3 and shows a pure blastic population.
ENKTL is angiocentric and necrotic with EBER positivity, features absent here.

ddx.dx: Cutaneous diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, leg type
ddx.vs: DLBCL cells have vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli and are CD20+/PAX5+/MUM1+, unlike B-lineage-negative BPDCN.

64143.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一顆巨核細胞，細胞體積偏小，核為單一、圓形、不分葉且位置偏心，周圍有淡紫色顆粒狀細胞質（顯示已成熟產生血小板顆粒）；這種單核圓形巨核細胞是 del(5q) 骨髓分化不良症候群的典型表現。
features: Megakaryocyte smaller than typical mature forms
Single round, non-lobated, eccentric nucleus with coarse granular chromatin
Moderate to abundant pale lilac granular cytoplasm indicating cytoplasmic maturation
Nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony (mature cytoplasm with non-lobated nucleus)
Background with red cells, small lymphoid-appearing cells, and a neutrophil; poor image resolution
64143.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a megakaryocyte with a single round, non-lobated, eccentrically placed nucleus and moderately abundant pale granular cytoplasm. The cell is smaller than a normal mature megakaryocyte, and the granular cytoplasm contrasts with the lack of nuclear lobation. Image resolution is limited. Findings are consistent with a mononuclear (hypolobated) dysplastic megakaryocyte, characteristic of myelodysplastic neoplasm with isolated del(5q).

ddx.vs: Immature megakaryocytes have deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm with blebs, whereas this cell has mature granular cytoplasm despite a round nucleus.
Micromegakaryocytes are near lymphocyte size with scant cytoplasm, while 5q- megakaryocytes are medium-sized with more abundant cytoplasm.
Osteoblasts have a paranuclear hof away from nucleus and occur in clusters, and plasma cells have basophilic cytoplasm, neither with fine platelet-type granules.

64079.recognize_zh: 低倍（A、B）見瀰漫成片、單調的小至中型細胞完全取代組織結構；高倍（C、D）細胞核細緻染色質、核膜不規則或扭曲（convoluted），伴隨許多核分裂與凋亡碎片，符合淋巴母細胞淋巴瘤（lymphoblastic lymphoma）。
features: Diffuse, monotonous sheets of small-to-intermediate cells effacing the tissue architecture (A, B)
High N:C ratio with scant cytoplasm
Irregular, focally convoluted nuclear contours (D)
Finely dispersed (blastic) chromatin with small inconspicuous to variably visible nucleoli
Numerous mitotic figures and apoptotic debris (C)
Delicate intervening vasculature without nodular or follicular architecture
64079.describe_en: Sections show a biopsy with complete effacement of the architecture by a diffuse, monotonous infiltrate extending to the capsular edge. At high power, the infiltrate consists of small-to-intermediate cells with scant cytoplasm, irregular to convoluted nuclear contours, finely dispersed chromatin and small nucleoli. Mitotic figures and apoptotic bodies are frequent. No follicular architecture or significant polymorphous inflammatory background is identified. Findings are consistent with lymphoblastic lymphoma; immunohistochemistry (TdT, CD34, CD1a, cytoplasmic CD3, CD19/PAX5) is required to confirm T-lineage.

ddx.vs: B-LBL is morphologically indistinguishable and is separated by PAX5/CD19/CD79a positivity and lack of CD3 on immunohistochemistry.
Burkitt shows medium-sized cells with round nuclei, clumped chromatin, multiple small nucleoli and a starry-sky pattern, and is TdT-negative with MYC rearrangement.
Blastoid MCL is TdT-negative and cyclin D1/SOX11 positive with CD5 and CD20 expression.

ddx.dx: Thymoma (type B/AB) with abundant immature T cells
ddx.vs: Thymoma contains a keratin-positive epithelial meshwork and lacks sheet-like destructive growth beyond lobules.

64015.recognize_zh: 中央一顆紅血球比周圍大一圈，胞質佈滿細小紅紫色點狀顆粒（Schüffner dots），內有厚實胞質環與一顆染色質點的環狀體，符合間日瘧（P. vivax）環狀體。
features: Single infected red cell clearly enlarged relative to neighbouring red cells, with slightly irregular oval outline
Fine, evenly distributed pink-purple stippling throughout the host cell (Schuffner dots)
Ring form with relatively thick cytoplasmic ring, central vacuole and a single prominent chromatin dot
Only one parasite per cell; no appliqué forms or multiple rings
Adjacent platelet lying beside the infected cell (not intraerythrocytic)
64015.describe_en: Thin peripheral blood film (Giemsa stain, high power) shows a single infected red cell that is noticeably enlarged compared with surrounding erythrocytes and contains fine, diffuse eosinophilic stippling consistent with Schuffner dots. Within it is a ring-form trophozoite with a relatively thick cytoplasmic ring, central vacuole and one chromatin dot. Uninfected red cells are unremarkable, and a platelet lies adjacent to the infected cell. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium vivax ring-form trophozoite.

ddx.vs: Falciparum rings are small and delicate, often double-dotted, multiple or appliqué, within normal-sized red cells lacking Schuffner dots (Maurer clefts only in later stages).
Ovale also enlarges the cell with James dots, but the host cell is typically oval with fimbriated ends; separation may require species PCR.
Babesia forms small, pleomorphic rings without pigment or stippling, may form tetrads (Maltese cross), and does not enlarge the red cell.
A superimposed platelet shows granular purple texture without a cytoplasmic ring, chromatin dot or host cell stippling.

63887.recognize_zh: 一顆比周圍紅血球大很多的巨大原紅血球（giant proerythroblast）：核圓大、染色質細緻偏紅紫、隱約可見核內顆粒，細胞質是一圈深藍色並帶小空泡與泡狀突起；在紅系再生不良（pure red cell aplasia）背景下，應想到 parvovirus B19 感染。
features: Single giant erythroid precursor several times the diameter of surrounding red cells
Large round nucleus with finely granular chromatin, reddish-purple tint and small pinkish nuclear granules/nucleoli
Narrow rim of intensely basophilic cytoplasm with a row of small clear vacuoles
Blunt cytoplasmic blebs/pseudopod-like projections at the cell edge
Background of red cells with rouleaux-like overlap; no other erythroid precursors in this field
63887.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a single giant proerythroblast, markedly larger than surrounding red cells. It has a large round nucleus with finely granular chromatin and small pinkish nuclear granules, a narrow rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing small vacuoles, and blunt cytoplasmic blebs. No maturing erythroid precursors are present in the field. In the setting of acquired pure red cell aplasia, giant proerythroblasts suggest parvovirus B19 infection, which should be confirmed by PCR or immunohistochemistry. Findings are consistent with a giant proerythroblast in pure red cell aplasia.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts have less intensely basophilic cytoplasm without the dark blue rim and blebs, and are MPO- or CD34-positive rather than E-cadherin/glycophorin-positive.
Megaloblastic change affects the whole erythroid series with abundant maturing megaloblasts and hypersegmented neutrophils, not isolated giant proerythroblasts in an erythroid-depleted marrow.
Pure erythroid leukemia shows sheets of proerythroblasts (≥30%) rather than rare scattered giant forms with erythroid hypoplasia.
Plasmablasts have an eccentric nucleus with a perinuclear hof and CD138 positivity, lacking the uniform deep-blue rim and dog-ear blebs.

63823.recognize_zh: 低倍視野中有大量小淋巴球，核深染、細胞質少，許多細胞在一端或兩端拖出極性的細胞質突起（polar villous projections），並夾雜很多粉紫色的破碎塗抹細胞（smudge cells）；小 B 淋巴球帶極性絨毛，是脾邊緣區淋巴瘤（SMZL）的典型血片。
features: Absolute lymphocytosis of small lymphocytes with round to oval, dense, clumped nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Many lymphocytes show short polar (unipolar or bipolar) cytoplasmic projections giving a tailed or spindle outline
No circumferential hairy projections and no prominent nucleoli
Numerous smudge cells scattered across the field
Normocytic red cells with scattered platelets
63823.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low-to-medium power shows a marked lymphocytosis composed of small lymphocytes with condensed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant cytoplasm. A substantial proportion of the lymphocytes display short polar cytoplasmic villous projections, and numerous smudge cells are present. Red cells and platelets are unremarkable in this field. Findings are consistent with a small B-cell lymphoproliferative disorder with villous lymphocytes, suggestive of splenic marginal zone lymphoma; flow cytometry (CD5-, CD10-, CD103-, CD25-/+ with CD11c variable) and splenic/marrow histology are required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Hairy cells are larger with abundant pale cytoplasm and fine circumferential hair-like projections and oval or bean-shaped nuclei, with CD103+ CD25+ CD11c+ CD123+ and BRAF V600E, and HCL rarely presents with high lymphocytosis.
CLL also has many smudge cells, but its cells are round without polar villi and are CD5+ CD23+ with dim surface immunoglobulin.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma / hairy cell leukemia variant
ddx.vs: These show broad-based villous projections distributed around the cell and, in HCL-variant, prominent nucleoli, with CD103 positivity in HCL-variant and red pulp rather than white pulp splenic infiltration.
MCL cells often have irregular or cleaved nuclei without villi and are CD5+ with cyclin D1/SOX11 and t(11;14).

63759.recognize_zh: Glycophorin A 免疫染色中，脂肪空泡之間大量細胞呈清楚的棕色細胞膜環狀陽性，插圖放大可見成群紅血球前驅細胞的膜染色，顯示紅血球系前驅細胞豐富且正常表現 glycophorin A。
features: Strong, crisp membranous glycophorin A staining in a large proportion of hematopoietic cells
Positive cells form clusters and cords between adipocytes, reflecting abundant erythroid precursors
Inset (100x) highlights ring-like membranous staining of round erythroid precursors
Negative (blue) nuclei of non-erythroid cells interspersed
Mature red cells in sinusoids also positive
63759.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for glycophorin A on the bone marrow biopsy shows strong membranous staining in abundant erythroid precursors arranged in clusters and cords between adipocytes, with the inset highlighting crisp ring-like membranous positivity. Non-erythroid cells are negative. The stain confirms that erythroid precursors are numerous and retain normal glycophorin A expression, providing an internal positive control for comparison with erythroid membrane skeletal proteins such as spectrin in this alpha-thalassemia-related workup.

ddx.vs: Sheets of immature, atypical proerythroblasts (≥30%) with frequent weak glycophorin A but strong CD71/E-cadherin, rather than maturing erythroid clusters.
Also shows abundant glycophorin A-positive maturing precursors; distinguished by clinical cause and normal morphology rather than by the stain.
Erythroid precursors are enlarged with open chromatin and asynchronous maturation, better appreciated on aspirate smears.

63695.recognize_zh: 一顆帶藍灰色（多染性）細胞質的晚期紅血球母細胞，其濃縮成深藍黑色的圓形小核被推到細胞邊緣、正從細胞膜脫出，符合紅血球母細胞脫核（enucleation）。
features: Late erythroblast with polychromatophilic blue-gray cytoplasm
Small, round, homogeneously dense pyknotic nucleus displaced to the cell edge and partly extruded
Nucleus bulges beyond the cytoplasmic outline
No nucleolus and no cytoplasmic granules
Background red cells with some crenation artifact and scattered platelets
63695.describe_en: Bone marrow smear field shows mature red cells, some with crenation artifact, and scattered platelets. The arrowed cell is a late (orthochromatic) erythroblast with polychromatophilic cytoplasm in which a small, dense, pyknotic nucleus is displaced to the periphery and appears to be extruding from the cell. No nuclear budding, karyorrhexis, or megaloblastic change is evident. Findings are consistent with physiologic erythroblast enucleation, which yields a reticulocyte and a free extruded nucleus (pyrenocyte).

ddx.vs: In budding a small lobule is attached to a retained central nucleus by a chromatin bridge, whereas here the entire pyknotic nucleus sits at the cell rim.
A Howell-Jolly body is a tiny intraerythrocytic nuclear remnant, far smaller than this nucleus.

ddx.dx: Small lymphocyte overlapping a red cell
ddx.vs: A lymphocyte shows chromatin texture and its own rim of cytoplasm and lies in a different plane from the red cell.

63631.recognize_zh: 周邊血中一顆偏心圓核、染色質呈塊狀（clock-face 樣）的漿細胞，細胞質深藍色，外緣呈紫紅色、邊界不規則如火焰般（flame cell），在骨髓瘤復發病人代表循環中的異常漿細胞。
features: Medium-sized cell larger than adjacent red cells with moderate N:C ratio
Eccentric round nucleus with coarsely clumped chromatin
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a reddish-purple (fuchsinophilic) frayed peripheral rim, characteristic of a flame cell
Irregular, ragged cytoplasmic border
Background red cells; image has a color cast and limited resolution
63631.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a circulating plasma cell with an eccentric round nucleus with coarsely clumped chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm. The cytoplasmic periphery has a reddish-purple, frayed appearance characteristic of flame cell morphology. The image has a color cast and limited resolution, so a perinuclear hof is not clearly assessable. In a patient with relapsed multiple myeloma, findings are consistent with circulating abnormal plasma cells of flame cell type; quantification on smear or flow cytometry is needed to determine whether criteria for plasma cell leukemia are met (≥5% circulating plasma cells).

ddx.vs: Reactive plasmacytoid lymphocytes in infections are smaller with less eccentric nuclei and lack the fuchsinophilic frayed rim, and are polyclonal on flow cytometry.
LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P.
Plasmablasts are larger with fine chromatin and prominent nucleoli rather than clumped mature chromatin.
Promyelocytes have azurophilic granules and a perinuclear clearing but lack clumped chromatin and flame-colored cytoplasm, and are MPO positive.

63567.recognize_zh: 中央有一顆胞質淡藍、帶細空泡的大巨噬細胞（nurse cell），周圍一圈大小不一、胞質由嗜鹼到多染的有核紅血球環繞，這種玫瑰花狀排列就是紅血球島（erythroblastic island）。
features: Central large macrophage with a round nucleus, open chromatin and pale grey-blue, finely vacuolated cytoplasm
Rosette of about a dozen erythroid precursors clustered tightly around the macrophage
Erythroblasts at mixed stages: larger basophilic (early) forms with finer chromatin and smaller polychromatophilic/orthochromatic forms with dense round nuclei
Round, regular nuclear contours without megaloblastic or dysplastic change visible
Background of blood-rich marrow aspirate with scattered isolated erythroblasts and a band/segmented granulocyte
63567.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (May-Grünwald-Giemsa) shows an erythroblastic island composed of a central macrophage with abundant pale, finely vacuolated cytoplasm surrounded by a rosette of erythroid precursors. The erythroblasts span multiple stages of maturation, from basophilic erythroblasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm to late polychromatophilic and orthochromatic normoblasts with condensed round nuclei. No megaloblastic change, nuclear budding or multinucleation is evident in this field. Findings are consistent with a normal erythroblastic island (nurse-cell niche) of erythropoiesis.

ddx.vs: Hemophagocytosis shows erythroid cells or other hematopoietic cells engulfed within the macrophage cytoplasm, whereas here the erythroblasts lie on the macrophage surface in an organized rosette.

ddx.dx: Tumor cell clump (e.g., metastatic small round cell tumor)
ddx.vs: Metastatic clusters are cohesive sheets of uniform atypical cells without a central macrophage or a spectrum of hemoglobinizing erythroid maturation.
Megaloblastic erythroblasts are larger with sieve-like open chromatin and nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, which is not seen in these compact, normally condensed nuclei.

63439.recognize_zh: 薄層血片中央有一團由許多（約十餘至二十個）紫紅色小顆粒狀裂殖子（merozoites）聚集而成的圓形結構，大小約與一顆紅血球相當，符合間日瘧原蟲（P. vivax）的成熟裂殖體（schizont）；周圍紅血球有乾燥折光假影。
features: Rounded parasite cluster about the size of a red cell containing numerous discrete chromatin dots
Approximately 12-24 merozoites irregularly arranged, favoring P. vivax over P. malariae rosettes
Faint golden-brown pigment and pale host cell outline not well delineated
Background red cells with refractile drying artifact
Neutrophil with ring-shaped nucleus at upper right and small platelet nearby
63439.describe_en: Thin peripheral blood smear shows a mature malarial schizont containing numerous discrete merozoites (approximately 12-24) filling a structure roughly the size of a red cell. The host red cell membrane is poorly delineated in this image, so enlargement and Schüffner stippling cannot be assessed. Background red cells show refractile drying artifact, and a neutrophil and platelets are present. Findings are consistent with a Plasmodium vivax schizont; species confirmation should include host cell size, Schüffner dots, other parasite stages, and PCR or rapid antigen testing if needed.

ddx.vs: P. ovale schizonts usually contain fewer merozoites (6-12) in an enlarged, oval, fimbriated red cell with prominent Schüffner dots.
P. malariae schizonts have 6-12 merozoites arranged in a rosette around central pigment in a normal-sized red cell.
Schizonts of P. falciparum are rarely seen in peripheral blood and are small with 16-24 merozoites in a normal-sized red cell, while P. knowlesi shows up to 16 merozoites with dense pigment.
Platelet clumps show granular purple material with irregular outlines and no discrete merozoite chromatin dots with cytoplasm.

63375.recognize_zh: 未染色的頭髮毛幹在光學顯微鏡下，黑色素沿髓質與皮質呈細長條狀、連續且均勻分布，看不到格里塞利症候群（Griscelli syndrome）特有的大型不規則色素團塊；這張是作為對照的正常色素型態。
features: Unstained hair shaft examined by light microscopy
Melanin pigment distributed as fine, continuous longitudinal streaks along the shaft
Pigment appears evenly spaced without large irregular clumps
No small regularly spaced giant granules as seen in Chediak-Higashi syndrome
Shaft contour intact without structural hair abnormalities; clear background
63375.describe_en: Light microscopy of an unstained hair shaft shows melanin pigment distributed as fine, evenly spaced longitudinal streaks along the length of the shaft. No large irregular pigment clumps or regularly spaced enlarged granules are identified, and the shaft contour is intact. This represents an evenly distributed pigment pattern, which serves as the comparison for the large irregular pigment clumps that characterize Griscelli syndrome type 2 in the case.

ddx.vs: Griscelli hair shows large, irregular clumps of pigment unevenly distributed, mainly in the medulla, rather than fine even streaks.
Chediak-Higashi hair contains small, regularly distributed enlarged melanin granules, and blood leukocytes show giant cytoplasmic granules.
Elejalde syndrome has large irregular pigment clumps similar to Griscelli but with primary neurologic disease and no HLH.

63311.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中有不少體積較小、缺乏中央淡染區的緻密紅血球（球形/不規則收縮細胞 irregularly contracted cells），另有鋸齒狀紅血球與紅血球碎片，搭配 dapsone 用藥史提示氧化性溶血；本圖中典型的咬痕細胞（bite cell）與水泡細胞（blister cell）並不明顯。
features: Mixed red cell population with numerous small, dense erythrocytes lacking central pallor (spherocytes/irregularly contracted cells)
Scattered cells with irregular, partially contracted or eccentric outlines and occasional red cell fragments
Crenated red cells (echinocytes), at least partly consistent with drying artifact
Occasional elongated/elliptical cell; normal-appearing platelets
Definite bite cells or blister cells with hemoglobin retraction are not convincingly seen in this field
63311.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows anisocytosis with numerous small, dense erythrocytes lacking central pallor, consistent with spherocytes and irregularly contracted cells, along with scattered crenated cells and occasional red cell fragments. Classic bite cells and blister cells with eccentric hemoglobin retraction are not clearly identified in this field, and Heinz bodies require a supravital stain for demonstration. Platelets appear adequate and no leukocytes are present in this field. In the setting of dapsone therapy, the findings are suggestive of oxidative hemolysis; confirmation with a Heinz body preparation, methemoglobin level and G6PD assay is recommended.

ddx.vs: HS shows uniform round microspherocytes with a positive family history and EMA-binding test, without drug exposure or irregularly contracted/bite cells.
AIHA produces spherocytes with polychromasia and a positive direct antiglobulin test, whereas oxidative hemolysis is DAT-negative with Heinz bodies.
Morphology is identical (bite and blister cells, Heinz bodies); separation requires G6PD enzyme assay performed after recovery from the acute episode.
Artifactual echinocytes are evenly spiculated with preserved size and appear in thick areas, whereas irregularly contracted cells are small, dense and unevenly shaped.

63183.recognize_zh: 周邊血紅血球大小不一且形狀多變：可見卵圓形大紅血球、橢圓形與淚滴狀細胞、碎片及棘狀細胞，底部有一顆核濃縮的有核紅血球（nRBC）。
features: Nucleated red blood cell with a small dense pyknotic nucleus (bottom of field)
Marked anisocytosis including oval macrocytes and microcytes
Poikilocytosis: elliptocytes, teardrop cells, fragmented cells and echinocytic/irregularly spiculated forms
Occasional red cell with a small dark inclusion/overlapping body and a few target-like cells
Platelets small and scattered
63183.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked red cell anisopoikilocytosis with oval macrocytes, microcytes, elliptocytes, teardrop cells, fragments and irregularly spiculated cells. A nucleated red blood cell with a condensed pyknotic nucleus is present. No blasts or leukocytes are seen in this field, and platelets appear small and sparse. In the clinical setting of a myelodysplastic neoplasm, findings are consistent with dyserythropoiesis with circulating nucleated red cells.

ddx.vs: Myelofibrosis shows prominent teardrop cells together with immature granulocytes and nRBCs (leukoerythroblastic picture); correlation with marrow fibrosis and driver mutations is needed.
Thalassemia shows uniformly microcytic hypochromic cells with target cells and basophilic stippling, rather than oval macrocytes.
Megaloblastic anemia also causes oval macrocytes and poikilocytes but is accompanied by hypersegmented neutrophils and low B12/folate.
MAHA shows numerous schistocytes (helmet and triangle forms) with thrombocytopenia as the dominant feature rather than oval macrocytes.

63119.recognize_zh: 右側嗜中性球細胞質內有兩顆與主核完全分離、圓形深紫的小包涵體（黑箭頭，Howell-Jolly body-like inclusion）；左側細胞核葉上的小附屬物（紅箭頭）與核相連，屬 Barr body。兩細胞並有毒性顆粒（toxic granulation）。
features: Two neutrophils with abundant cytoplasm containing coarse, dark toxic granules
Right neutrophil: small round, dense basophilic cytoplasmic inclusions completely separate from the nucleus (Howell-Jolly body-like inclusions, black arrows)
Left neutrophil: small nuclear appendage attached to a lobe (Barr body-type appendage, red arrow)
Coarsely condensed nuclear chromatin with hypolobated/band-like nuclear contour in right cell
Background red cells with central refractile drying artifact
63119.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows neutrophils with toxic granulation. One neutrophil contains small, round, deeply basophilic cytoplasmic inclusions that are completely separate from the nucleus and resemble erythrocytic Howell-Jolly bodies (black arrows). The adjacent neutrophil shows a small appendage attached to a nuclear lobe, representing a sex-chromatin (Barr body-type) appendage (red arrow) rather than a free inclusion. Red cells show refractile drying artifact. Findings are consistent with Howell-Jolly body-like inclusions in neutrophils with toxic change, here associated with SARS-CoV-2 infection.

ddx.vs: Döhle bodies are pale blue-grey, irregular, peripheral cytoplasmic patches of rough ER, whereas HJBLIs are small, dense, round, dark purple nuclear-type fragments.
Morulae are larger, stippled mulberry-like clusters of organisms rather than single homogeneous round dense dots.
MYH9-related inclusions are larger, pale blue, spindle-shaped Döhle-like bodies accompanied by giant platelets and thrombocytopenia.
A drumstick is attached to a nuclear lobe by a thin chromatin strand, whereas HJBLIs lie free in the cytoplasm.

63055.recognize_zh: A 圖骨髓切片中箭頭所指是大型、核仁明顯的非典型細胞，混在造血細胞間；B 圖抹片中巨噬細胞吞噬多個有核細胞（噬血現象）；D 圖膜性染色的大細胞沿骨髓竇狀隙呈線狀分支排列，提示血管內大 B 細胞淋巴瘤合併噬血症候群。
features: Panel A (H&E): hypercellular marrow with scattered large atypical cells (arrows) having vesicular nuclei, prominent nucleoli and moderate cytoplasm
Panel B (aspirate): macrophage with vacuolated cytoplasm engulfing nucleated hematopoietic cells (hemophagocytosis)
Panel C: nuclear immunostain highlighting clusters of positive cells scattered in the interstitium (marker not specified in the image)
Panel D: membranous immunostain outlining large cells confined to linear, branching sinusoidal channels (intrasinusoidal pattern)
Background fat with preserved trilineage hematopoiesis around the infiltrate
63055.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow in which scattered large atypical lymphoid cells with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli are admixed with hematopoietic elements. The aspirate contains histiocytes with active hemophagocytosis of nucleated cells. Immunohistochemistry highlights the large cells in a predominantly linear, branching intrasinusoidal distribution on a membranous stain, while a nuclear stain decorates clusters of interstitial cells. Findings are consistent with intravascular large B-cell lymphoma involving bone marrow with associated hemophagocytic syndrome; lineage should be confirmed with CD20/PAX5.

ddx.vs: Infection-associated HLH shows hemophagocytosis but lacks large atypical B cells confined to sinusoids on CD20/PAX5 staining.
HSTCL also has a sinusoidal pattern but its cells are medium-sized, CD3+ CD5- gamma-delta T cells, not large CD20+ B cells.
ANKL cells are CD56+, cytoplasmic CD3+, EBER+ and circulate in blood, unlike CD20+ intravascular B cells.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma with marrow involvement
ddx.vs: Conventional DLBCL forms nodular or diffuse interstitial masses rather than being restricted to vascular/sinusoidal lumina.

63055.stain: H&E, Wright-Giemsa, IHC (nuclear and membranous markers)

62991.recognize_zh: 油鏡下 CD117 在細長紡錘形細胞呈強烈、顆粒狀的細胞質與膜陽性，細胞沿同一方向排列，核呈卵圓至細長形，符合非典型紡錘形肥大細胞。
features: Elongated spindle-shaped cells with oval to elongated nuclei
Strong granular cytoplasmic and membranous CD117 staining outlining cell processes
Cells aligned in a streaming parallel arrangement
Occasional round positive cells with central nuclei
Intermixed CD117-negative cells with blue nuclei
62991.describe_en: CD117 immunostain at oil immersion shows numerous elongated spindle-shaped cells with strong granular cytoplasmic and membranous staining, arranged in a streaming pattern. The nuclei are oval to elongated with fine chromatin. Admixed negative cells are present. Findings are consistent with atypical spindled mast cells, a morphologic minor criterion (>25% spindled/atypical mast cells) of systemic mastocytosis.

ddx.vs: Reactive mast cells are round to oval with central nuclei and are scattered rather than spindled and aggregated, and are CD25-negative.
GIST cells are CD117+ spindle cells but are DOG1+ and tryptase-negative.
Fibroblasts are spindled but CD117-negative.

62927.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸片可見成團的小圓藍細胞，細胞核圓、彼此擠壓（nuclear molding），並嵌在粉紫色纖維狀基質（neuropil）中形成合胞體樣團塊；這種成團排列與背景纖維物質提示轉移性神經母細胞瘤，而非散在分布的淋巴母細胞。
features: Cohesive clusters of small round blue cells embedded in pink-purple fibrillary matrix (neuropil)
Small to intermediate cells with high N:C ratio and round, hyperchromatic nuclei
Nuclear crowding and molding within clusters
Scant, ill-defined cytoplasm; many crushed/smudged cells with streaked chromatin
Tumor cells arranged in syncytial aggregates rather than as dispersed single cells
62927.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows large cohesive aggregates of small round blue cells in a syncytial pattern. The cells have high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, round hyperchromatic nuclei with nuclear molding, and scant indistinct cytoplasm, and are set within a pale pink-purple fibrillary background consistent with neuropil. Numerous crushed cells are present; well-formed Homer Wright rosettes are not clearly seen in this field. The clustering and neurofibrillary matrix favor a metastatic small round blue cell tumor over leukemia, and in this clinical context findings are consistent with metastatic neuroblastoma, confirmed by CD45-negative/CD56-positive flow cytometry and synaptophysin/NSE immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts are discohesive single cells without neuropil or rosettes and are CD45+, TdT+ with B- or T-lineage markers.
Also forms clusters of small round cells but lacks neuropil, is CD99 membranous and NKX2.2 positive, and carries EWSR1 rearrangement.
Tumor cells may cluster and show vacuolated cytoplasm but are myogenin/desmin positive and lack neuropil.
Can show similar rosettes, but clinical site and markers (e.g., lack of PHOX2B, catecholamine metabolites) separate them from neuroblastoma.

62863.recognize_zh: Perls 鐵染色（紅色對比染色）下，數顆紅血球母細胞的核周圍排列著藍黑色鐵顆粒，呈部分或完整環狀（ring sideroblasts）；背景有大量針狀結晶樣染色沉澱物，影像對焦有限。
features: Erythroblasts (red counterstained nuclei) with coarse blue-black iron granules arranged around the nuclear rim
Several cells show perinuclear granules encircling a substantial part of the nucleus (ring sideroblasts)
Occasional larger dark iron aggregates adjacent to cells
Background of needle-like crystalline precipitate, likely stain/processing artifact
Suboptimal focus limits counting of granules per cell
62863.describe_en: Perls Prussian blue stain of a bone marrow aspirate smear, shown in a main field and two insets, highlights erythroblasts with coarse blue-black siderotic granules arranged in a perinuclear distribution, encircling a substantial portion of the nucleus in several cells, consistent with ring sideroblasts. The background contains abundant needle-like crystalline precipitate, most likely stain artifact, and the image is somewhat out of focus, which limits precise counting. Formal quantification (percentage of ring sideroblasts among erythroblasts, with at least five granules covering one third of the nuclear circumference) should be performed on a well-stained smear. Findings are consistent with sideroblastic anemia, in this case X-linked sideroblastic anemia.

ddx.vs: Normal sideroblasts contain only a few fine granules scattered randomly in the cytoplasm rather than coarse granules encircling the nucleus.
Ring sideroblasts look identical; separation relies on age, multilineage dysplasia, SF3B1 mutation versus ALAS2 or other germline mutations.

ddx.dx: Acquired reversible sideroblastic states (alcohol, copper deficiency, isoniazid, zinc toxicity)
ddx.vs: Ring sideroblasts are morphologically similar, so history, copper/zinc levels and drug exposure are required to distinguish them.

62799.recognize_zh: 這是鹼性（pH 8.6）醋酸纖維膜血紅素電泳條，箭頭所指的樣本在S/D/G位置有一條明顯粗帶，F位置僅有淡帶，缺乏正常HbA帶，提示鐮刀型貧血（HbSS）；需與HPLC或酸性電泳確認S而非D/G。
features: Cellulose acetate strip at alkaline pH with multiple applied samples showing separated hemoglobin bands
Arrowed sample: dominant band at the S/D/G migration position
Faint adjacent band corresponding to the HbF position in the arrowed sample
Other samples show band patterns at different positions serving as comparison/controls
Non-morphologic image; band identity cannot distinguish HbS from HbD or HbG at alkaline pH
62799.describe_en: Cellulose acetate hemoglobin electrophoresis at alkaline pH (8.6) is shown with several samples run in parallel. The patient sample (arrow) shows a prominent band in the S/D/G region with a faint band in the F region and no clearly separate HbA band, while adjacent samples provide comparison patterns. Because HbS, HbD and HbG co-migrate at alkaline pH, confirmation by acid (citrate agar) electrophoresis, HPLC or a solubility test is required. In context, findings are consistent with homozygous sickle cell disease (HbSS) with a modest HbF fraction.

ddx.vs: HbD co-migrates with HbS at alkaline pH but separates with HbA on acid citrate agar electrophoresis and gives a negative sickle solubility test.
HbS/β0-thalassemia shows the same S band with no HbA but an elevated HbA2 (>3.5%) and microcytosis on CBC.
HbAS shows both an A band and an S band with HbA exceeding HbS, unlike the single dominant S band here.

62735.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中組織球胞質內充滿針狀、交錯的淡藍色結晶（A–C）；免疫染色 kappa 與 lambda 在結晶本身皆不著色（D），電顯可見電子緻密、無內部結構的六角形結晶（E），質譜偵測到 IgG 恆定區與 kappa 輕鏈（F），整合為輕鏈結晶儲積組織球增生症。
features: Histiocytes with cytoplasm packed by pale blue, needle-shaped to rhomboid crystals in a criss-cross pattern (A-C)
Crystal-laden histiocytes scattered among normal hematopoietic cells on low power (A, B)
Crystals appear as unstained negative images on kappa and lambda immunohistochemistry (D)
Electron microscopy shows electron-dense hexagonal and rhomboid crystals without internal periodicity (E)
Mass spectrometry table highlighting immunoglobulin gamma-1 heavy chain constant region and kappa constant region peptides (F)
62735.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show increased histiocytes whose cytoplasm is distended by numerous pale blue, elongated needle-like and rhomboid crystals arranged haphazardly; no hemophagocytosis is identified. Immunohistochemistry for kappa and lambda light chains shows the crystals as unstained negative images, while electron microscopy demonstrates electron-dense hexagonal crystals without internal substructure. Laser microdissection/mass spectrometry identifies IgG heavy chain constant region and kappa light chain peptides. Findings are consistent with crystal-storing histiocytosis due to kappa light chain crystals in the setting of a monoclonal gammopathy, illustrating that negative immunostaining does not exclude immunoglobulin crystals.

ddx.vs: Cytoplasm shows fine 'wrinkled tissue paper' striations rather than discrete refractile crystals, and electron microscopy shows tubular glucocerebroside inclusions rather than dense hexagonal crystals.
Charcot-Leyden crystals are bipyramidal, eosinophilic and associated with eosinophil-rich infiltrates, and are composed of galectin-10 rather than immunoglobulin.

ddx.dx: Lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma or myeloma with crystal-storing histiocytosis
ddx.vs: Morphology of the histiocytes is identical, so an overt clonal B-cell or plasma cell population must be excluded by flow cytometry and biopsy immunohistochemistry.
Drug crystals are associated with medication history and do not contain immunoglobulin by mass spectrometry.

62735.stain: Wright-Giemsa; IHC: kappa, lambda; EM; mass spectrometry

62607.recognize_zh: 密集的漿細胞樣細胞（核偏位、染色質呈車輪狀、細胞質嗜雙染色）成片浸潤並分隔粉紅色平滑肌束，形成破壞性腫塊，於移植病人背景下符合漿細胞瘤樣 PTLD。
features: Dense diffuse infiltrate dissecting eosinophilic smooth muscle bundles
Monotonous plasmacytoid cells with eccentric round nuclei and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm
Clock-face to vesicular chromatin; some cells larger with visible nucleoli
Occasional binucleate or enlarged atypical plasma cells
Scattered small vessels; no germinal centers or polymorphous inflammatory background evident
62607.describe_en: Sections show a dense, destructive infiltrate of plasma cells and plasmacytoid cells that dissects through smooth muscle bundles. The cells have eccentric round nuclei, clumped to vesicular chromatin and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm, with scattered larger atypical forms. The infiltrate is monotonous without a polymorphous background of small lymphocytes, histiocytes or eosinophils. In a transplant recipient, with EBER positivity and light-chain restriction, findings are consistent with monomorphic post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder, plasmacytoma-like type.

ddx.vs: Plasmacytic hyperplasia preserves architecture and is polytypic, whereas this infiltrate is destructive and monotypic.
Plasmablastic lymphoma consists of large immunoblastic cells with prominent central nucleoli and high Ki-67, rather than predominantly mature-appearing plasma cells.
Polymorphic PTLD shows a full spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasma cells and immunoblasts with CD20+ B cells, not a monotonous plasma cell sheet.

ddx.dx: Extramedullary spread of plasma cell myeloma
ddx.vs: Myeloma requires marrow involvement, serum/urine M-protein and CRAB features, and is usually EBV-negative.

62543.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片高倍下可見成群的紅血球前驅細胞島，其中混有較大、染色質細緻、核仁可見的未成熟紅系母細胞（左移），並散在棕色含鐵血黃素，呼應兒童難治性血球減少症（RCC）常見的紅系左移聚落。
features: Clusters of erythroid precursors ranging from larger immature forms (round nuclei, finer chromatin, small nucleoli, amphophilic cytoplasm) to small dark orthochromatic normoblasts
Left-shifted erythroid islands with increased proportion of immature erythroblasts
Scattered granulocytic cells, fewer in number than erythroid elements in this field
Scattered golden-brown hemosiderin pigment in macrophages
Megakaryocytes not conspicuous in this field; bony trabecula at lower left
62543.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows clusters of erythroid precursors with a relative increase in immature, larger erythroblasts showing finer chromatin and small nucleoli, admixed with maturing normoblasts. Granulocytic elements are present but relatively sparse, and scattered hemosiderin-laden macrophages are seen. Megakaryocytes are not well represented in this field, so micromegakaryocytes cannot be assessed here. Blasts are not increased in this field. In the appropriate clinical context, findings are consistent with refractory cytopenia of childhood.

ddx.vs: Aplastic anemia shows markedly hypocellular fatty marrow without left-shifted erythroid islands or micromegakaryocytes; residual islands, if present, are small and mature.

ddx.dx: Inherited bone marrow failure (e.g. Fanconi anemia)
ddx.vs: Morphology can overlap, so chromosomal breakage testing and germline genetic studies are needed to exclude an inherited syndrome.
Megaloblastic anemia shows marked nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony with giant metamyelocytes and responds to B12/folate replacement, rather than persistent left-shifted islands with cytopenias.

62479.recognize_zh: 脾臟切片 CD20 染色低倍下可見白髓結節明顯擴大且融合，CD20 強陽性，結節之間的紅髓也散布大量 CD20 陽性 B 細胞，符合脾邊緣區淋巴瘤（SMZL）的白髓擴張合併紅髓浸潤型態。
features: Low-power view of splenic parenchyma, IHC CD20
Markedly expanded, confluent nodules of diffusely and strongly CD20-positive B cells (white pulp expansion)
Nodules show a monotonous staining pattern without a distinct pale germinal center-mantle-marginal zone layering
Intervening red pulp contains numerous CD20-positive cells in cords and sinusoids (red pulp involvement)
Scattered CD20-negative stromal and vascular elements between nodules
62479.describe_en: Section of spleen immunostained for CD20 shows markedly expanded, partly confluent white pulp nodules composed of sheets of strongly CD20-positive B cells. The intervening red pulp is also infiltrated by numerous CD20-positive cells in a cordal and sinusoidal distribution. The nodules lack an obvious residual follicular architecture at this magnification. Findings support a B-cell lymphoproliferative disorder with white and red pulp involvement, consistent with splenic marginal zone lymphoma in the appropriate morphologic and immunophenotypic context.

ddx.vs: Reactive white pulp retains polarized germinal centers with CD10/BCL6-positive, BCL2-negative centers and a distinct mantle, and red pulp B cells are sparse rather than diffusely infiltrative.
HCL diffusely infiltrates red pulp with atrophic white pulp and blood lakes, and is CD25, CD103, annexin A1 and BRAF V600E positive.
FL nodules are CD10 and BCL6 positive with BCL2-positive germinal centers and often carry t(14;18), whereas SMZL is CD10 negative.
MCL is CD5 and cyclin D1/SOX11 positive, which SMZL lacks.

62351.recognize_zh: IgD 染色中寬大的外套區呈強陽性棕色，裡面有兩個相鄰、IgD 陰性的小生發中心被同一個外套區包住（twinning 雙生發中心），外圍濾泡間區則為陰性，符合透明血管型 Castleman 病。
features: Strong membranous IgD staining of a markedly expanded mantle zone
Two adjacent small IgD-negative germinal centers enclosed within a single mantle zone (twinning)
Additional small IgD-negative foci corresponding to vessels or tiny regressed centers
Sharp boundary between the IgD-positive mantle and IgD-negative interfollicular T-zone at the lower right
Concentric arrangement of cells visible in the largest germinal center
62351.describe_en: IgD immunohistochemistry on a lymph node highlights a markedly expanded mantle zone of small B cells with strong membranous staining. Within this single mantle zone there are two adjacent small, IgD-negative germinal centers (twinning), along with smaller negative foci representing vessels or minute regressed centers. The interfollicular region at the periphery is IgD-negative. The staining confirms that the thickened mantle is composed of naive IgD-positive mantle B cells. Findings are consistent with Castleman disease, hyaline vascular type.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma, mantle zone pattern
ddx.vs: MCL cells are often IgD-positive as well, so the discriminator is cyclin D1/SOX11 and CD5 positivity with light-chain restriction in MCL but not in Castleman mantles.
Marginal zone lymphoma cells are typically IgD-negative and grow outside a residual IgD-positive mantle, the opposite of the diffusely IgD-positive expanded mantle here.
Reactive follicles have large, active germinal centers with thin IgD-positive mantles, not tiny atretic centers within broad mantles.

62287.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中紅血球前驅細胞增多，一個大型細胞正處於有絲分裂，多個前驅細胞染色質開放但細胞質已呈多色性（核質不同步），右下可見含 Howell-Jolly 樣核碎片的晚期細胞與不規則核碎裂，符合巨母紅血球性貧血的無效造血。
features: Erythroid hyperplasia with numerous enlarged erythroid precursors
Large cell with mitotic figure and abundant blue cytoplasm (upper left)
Polychromatic erythroblasts retaining open, stippled chromatin (nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony)
Late erythroid cell containing a round dense nuclear remnant (Howell-Jolly-like body)
Irregular, fragmented dense nuclear material suggesting karyorrhexis/dyserythropoiesis
Background oval macrocytes and teardrop forms
62287.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows erythroid hyperplasia with enlarged erythroid precursors displaying open, stippled chromatin that is immature relative to their polychromatic cytoplasm. A large precursor in mitosis is present, and a late erythroid cell contains a round dense nuclear remnant resembling a Howell-Jolly body, with nearby irregular fragmented nuclear material consistent with karyorrhexis. Background red cells include oval macrocytes and occasional teardrop forms. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic anemia with ineffective erythropoiesis.

ddx.vs: Karyorrhexis and nuclear fragments also occur in MDS, which is separated by multilineage dysplasia, clonal cytogenetics and failure to respond to B12/folate.
CDA shows binucleated/multinucleated erythroblasts and internuclear chromatin bridges with normal-sized granulocytic precursors.
Pure erythroid leukemia shows sheets of immature proerythroblasts with vacuoles rather than a maturing erythroid series.
Howell-Jolly bodies in hyposplenism appear in mature red cells of the blood without megaloblastic marrow precursors.

62223.recognize_zh: 淋巴結左下為小淋巴球區，右上則由成巢、細胞質淡粉紅的多角形上皮細胞取代皮質並延伸到被膜，右下可見被膜外脂肪組織，屬於轉移性乳管癌侵犯腋下淋巴結。
features: Nests and sheets of polygonal epithelial cells with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm in the upper right cortex
Enlarged pleomorphic nuclei with vesicular chromatin and nucleoli
Tumor extends toward and into the fibrous capsule
Residual dense small-lymphocyte area at the lower left
Perinodal adipose tissue at the lower right; scattered pigment-laden macrophages at left
62223.describe_en: Section of lymph node shows residual lymphoid tissue in the lower left and an infiltrate of cohesive nests and sheets of polygonal epithelial cells occupying the cortex in the upper right. The tumor cells have pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and enlarged pleomorphic nuclei with nucleoli, and the infiltrate extends to the fibrous capsule adjacent to perinodal adipose tissue. Findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma, compatible with metastatic ductal carcinoma of the breast; assessment for extranodal extension is warranted.

ddx.vs: Histiocytes fill sinuses with bland oval nuclei and foamy cytoplasm and are CD68/CD163 positive, cytokeratin negative.
Lobular carcinoma infiltrates as discohesive single cells or single files that mimic histiocytes and lacks E-cadherin, rather than cohesive nests.
Melanoma forms sheets of epithelioid cells with prominent nucleoli that are S100/SOX10/Melan-A positive and cytokeratin negative.

ddx.dx: Benign epithelial inclusions / ectopic breast tissue
ddx.vs: Benign inclusions form bland ducts with a preserved myoepithelial layer (p63, SMMHC) rather than atypical solid nests.

62159.recognize_zh: 中央一顆單核球（monocyte）胞質內含一顆完整紅血球並伴空泡，即紅血球吞噬（erythrophagocytosis）；背景紅血球成團聚集，提示冷凝集素造成的自體免疫溶血。
features: Monocyte/macrophage with vacuolated grey-blue cytoplasm containing an intact engulfed red cell
Irregular clumps of overlapping red cells consistent with RBC agglutination
Many crenated red cells (echinocytes), likely drying/storage artifact
Band and segmented neutrophils without toxic change; a small lymphocyte adjacent to the phagocyte
Scattered normal-appearing platelets
62159.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows red cells arranged in irregular clumps suggestive of agglutination, with numerous crenated forms that likely reflect artifact. A monocyte with vacuolated cytoplasm contains an intact phagocytosed erythrocyte. Accompanying neutrophils and a lymphocyte are morphologically unremarkable, and platelets are present. Erythrophagocytosis in blood, together with red cell agglutination, is consistent with antibody-mediated hemolysis such as cold agglutinin disease; correlation with direct antiglobulin test (C3d) and cold agglutinin titer is recommended.

ddx.vs: Rouleaux are linear stacks of red cells like coins, whereas agglutination forms irregular three-dimensional clumps that disperse on warming in cold agglutinin disease.
Warm AIHA typically shows prominent microspherocytes with IgG-positive DAT rather than cold-reactive agglutinates with C3d-only DAT.
HLH is diagnosed on marrow/tissue with activated histiocytes engulfing multiple cell lineages and clinical criteria, not a single erythrophagocytic monocyte with agglutination in blood.
PCH can also show erythrophagocytosis by neutrophils but is identified by a biphasic Donath-Landsteiner IgG antibody rather than IgM cold agglutinins.

62095.recognize_zh: 流式細胞圖中紅色母細胞族群 CD45 弱、CD34 陽性且部分表現 CD42b（巨核母細胞），同時表現胞質 CD3（cyCD3，T 系）；周邊血母細胞有細胞質泡突（blebs），骨髓切片見多形性母細胞，雙重免疫染色支持 T/巨核母細胞混合表型急性白血病。
features: A (CD45 vs SSC): blast population (red) with dim CD45 and low SSC, distinct from lymphocytes (blue) and granulocytes (orange)
B (CD42b vs CD34): blasts are CD34-positive with a subset co-expressing CD42b (megakaryocytic)
C (CD45 vs cytoplasmic CD3): blasts show cytoplasmic CD3 expression at a lower CD45 intensity than normal T cells
D (PB smear): medium-sized blasts with high N:C ratio, dense chromatin, and cytoplasmic blebs/budding
E (marrow H&E): sheets of pleomorphic blasts with irregular nuclei and occasional dysplastic megakaryocytic forms
F (dual IHC): co-localized brown nuclear and red membranous/cytoplasmic staining in the infiltrate (antibodies not labeled)
62095.describe_en: This composite combines flow cytometry and morphology. Flow cytometry identifies a CD45-dim, low side-scatter blast population that is CD34-positive, partly CD42b-positive, and expresses cytoplasmic CD3, indicating concurrent megakaryoblastic and T-lineage differentiation. The peripheral blood smear shows medium-sized blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios and cytoplasmic blebs typical of megakaryoblasts, and the marrow biopsy shows sheets of pleomorphic blasts, with a dual immunohistochemical stain highlighting co-expressing cells (markers not labeled). Findings are consistent with mixed-phenotype acute leukemia with T-lineage and megakaryoblastic features, a rare entity outside the standard WHO MPAL lineage combinations.

ddx.dx: Acute megakaryoblastic leukemia with aberrant CD7
ddx.vs: AMKL may express CD7 but lacks bright cytoplasmic CD3, which is the defining T-lineage marker here.
ETP-ALL expresses cyCD3 with stem/myeloid markers (CD34, CD117, CD33) but not megakaryocytic CD41/CD42b/CD61.
T/myeloid MPAL requires MPO or monocytic differentiation rather than megakaryocytic antigens such as CD42b.

62095.stain: Flow cytometry; Wright-Giemsa; H&E; dual IHC

61967.recognize_zh: 低倍皮膚 H&E 可見真皮全層密集的淋巴球浸潤，呈結節至瀰漫性分布並包圍毛囊，表皮與浸潤之間大致保留，無明顯親表皮性（epidermotropism）；以小淋巴球為主的真皮結節性浸潤，符合 CD4+ 小/中型 T 細胞增生性疾病的低倍結構。
features: Low-power skin with a dense dermal lymphoid infiltrate extending through the reticular dermis
Nodular to diffuse architecture with perifollicular and interstitial distribution between collagen bundles
Cells are predominantly small, dark lymphocytes at this magnification
Overlying epidermis is relatively thin with no significant epidermotropism
Hair follicle and adnexal structures are surrounded but preserved
No necrosis or ulceration visible
61967.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of skin shows a dense, nodular to diffuse lymphoid infiltrate occupying the superficial and reticular dermis, dissecting between collagen bundles and surrounding preserved hair follicles. The overlying epidermis is intact without significant epidermotropism, ulceration or necrosis. At this magnification the infiltrate appears to be composed predominantly of small lymphocytes. Findings are consistent with a dense dermal lymphoid proliferation compatible with primary cutaneous CD4-positive small/medium T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder, requiring high-power evaluation and immunohistochemistry (CD3, CD4, CD8, PD-1, CD20, CD30) for confirmation.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous marginal zone lymphoproliferative disorder
ddx.vs: Marginal zone lymphoproliferations are B-cell predominant with pale monocytoid cells, reactive follicles and monotypic plasma cells, identified by CD20 and light-chain ISH.
Mycosis fungoides shows a band-like superficial infiltrate with epidermotropism and Pautrier microabscesses rather than a deep dermal nodule sparing the epidermis.
Pseudolymphoma often shows reactive germinal centers, a top-heavy mixed infiltrate with eosinophils and plasma cells, and lacks PD-1+ atypical medium-sized T cells.

61903.recognize_zh: 皮膚表皮角質細胞明顯細胞內水腫、網狀變性（reticular degeneration），被拉長成細絲狀並形成表皮內水泡，真皮乳頭層有淋巴球浸潤與紅血球外滲；這是水痘樣（hydroa vacciniforme）病灶的表皮水泡期變化，需搭配真皮的EBV陽性T/NK細胞浸潤判斷。
features: Epidermis with marked intracellular edema and reticular degeneration, keratinocytes stretched into thin strands
Formation of intraepidermal vesicles/spaces with a preserved basket-weave stratum corneum
Scattered lymphocytes within the degenerating epidermis
Papillary dermis with lymphocytic infiltrate, edema and extravasated red cells
No multinucleated viral cytopathic keratinocytes evident in this field
61903.describe_en: Skin biopsy shows an epidermis with marked intracellular edema and reticular degeneration, with keratinocytes stretched into thin strands forming intraepidermal vesicles beneath an intact basket-weave stratum corneum. Scattered lymphocytes are present within the epidermis, and the papillary dermis shows edema, a lymphocytic infiltrate and extravasated red cells. Multinucleated keratinocytes with viral inclusions are not identified. These changes represent an early vesiculating lesion; in the appropriate clinical setting with a dermal EBV (EBER)-positive cytotoxic T/NK-cell infiltrate, they are consistent with hydroa vacciniforme lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.vs: Herpesvirus vesicles show ballooning keratinocytes with multinucleation, nuclear molding and margination, which are not seen here.
Erythema multiforme shows basal vacuolar change with numerous apoptotic keratinocytes rather than reticular degeneration with a dense dermal EBV-positive infiltrate.
Classic self-limited HV has a sparse infiltrate with few EBER-positive cells and no systemic disease, whereas HV-LPD shows a denser, deeper EBV-positive T/NK infiltrate.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous CD8+ aggressive epidermotropic T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: This lymphoma shows pagetoid epidermotropism by atypical CD8+ cells with epidermal necrosis and is EBER-negative.

61839.recognize_zh: NPM1 免疫染色（紅色呈色劑）中，大片白血病細胞不只核、連細胞質也染成紅色（異常細胞質位移，NPM1c），少數細胞或內皮則只有核著色或未染；細胞質 NPM1 表現可作為 NPM1 突變的替代指標。
features: Clusters of large leukemic cells with round to oval nuclei and moderate cytoplasm
Strong red staining of both nuclei and cytoplasm (aberrant cytoplasmic NPM1) in most leukemic cells
Scattered cells with staining restricted to the nucleus or with only blue counterstain, serving as internal comparison
Mixed marrow background with residual hematopoietic cells and red cells
Fat space present; alkaline phosphatase (red) chromogen
61839.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy immunostained for nucleophosmin (NPM1) with a red chromogen shows clusters and sheets of large leukemic cells with intense staining of both the nucleus and the cytoplasm. Scattered background cells, including elongated endothelial-type cells, show nucleus-restricted staining or are negative, providing an internal control for normal nuclear localization. Aberrant cytoplasmic NPM1 localization correlates closely with NPM1 exon 12 mutation. Findings are consistent with persistent acute myeloid leukemia with NPM1 mutation, which should be confirmed and monitored molecularly.

ddx.vs: Wild-type NPM1 blasts show staining confined to the nucleus (nucleoli), without the cytoplasmic signal seen here.
Normal regenerating precursors retain nucleus-restricted NPM1 staining, so cytoplasmic positivity in a cluster indicates residual mutant leukemia.
Artifactual cytoplasmic signal would also involve endothelial and stromal cells, whereas here those cells retain nuclear-only staining.

61775.recognize_zh: S100 免疫染色中大型組織球的細胞核與細胞質呈強棕色陽性，中央一顆 S100 陽性組織球內包著數個未染色的藍色淋巴球核，突顯 emperipolesis；周圍小淋巴球為陰性，符合 Rosai-Dorfman disease。
features: Strong nuclear and cytoplasmic brown S100 staining in large histiocytes with abundant cytoplasm
Central S100-positive histiocyte outlines several engulfed, S100-negative lymphocytes, highlighting emperipolesis
Background small lymphocytes are negative with blue hematoxylin counterstain
Diffuse granular brown staining in interstitial histiocytic cytoplasm between lymphocytes
Engulfed cells have intact round nuclei within the stained cytoplasm
61775.describe_en: S100 immunohistochemistry shows strong nuclear and cytoplasmic positivity in large histiocytes. The stain outlines histiocytes containing multiple intact, S100-negative lymphocytes within their cytoplasm, accentuating emperipolesis, while the background small lymphocytes are negative. Findings are consistent with Rosai-Dorfman disease, which is further characterized by OCT2 and cyclin D1 positivity with CD1a and langerin negativity in the lesional histiocytes.

ddx.vs: Also S100 positive, but lesional cells are CD1a and langerin positive with grooved nuclei and no emperipolesis.
S100-positive spindle to ovoid cells form fascicles or whorls with atypia and lack the engulfed lymphocytes seen here.
Shows S100 positivity in cohesive atypical cells with macronucleoli that also express SOX10, HMB45 or Melan-A.
Sinus histiocytes are S100 negative (CD68/CD163 positive) and lack emperipolesis.

61711.recognize_zh: G 帶染色的男性核型圖（XY），紅色箭頭標示第 1、11、13 號染色體的結構異常，而第 15 與 17 號看起來成對、未被標示；表示此 APL 病例的 PML::RARA 可能為隱匿性或複雜重組，需以 FISH 或 RT-PCR 確認。
features: G-banded karyotype arranged 1-22, X, Y (male)
Red arrows mark apparent structural abnormalities on one homolog each of chromosomes 1, 11, and 13
One chromosome 11 appears to carry additional material on the long arm
Chromosomes 15 and 17 are paired without an arrow or obvious rearrangement at this band resolution
Moderate banding resolution limits breakpoint assignment
61711.describe_en: G-banded karyotype from a male shows arrows indicating structural abnormalities involving one homolog each of chromosomes 1, 11, and 13, with one chromosome 11 appearing to carry extra long-arm material. Chromosomes 15 and 17 are not flagged and show no obvious t(15;17) at this resolution, so exact breakpoints and partner chromosomes cannot be assigned from the image. In a case of acute promyelocytic leukemia, this suggests a complex or variant rearrangement or a cryptic PML::RARA fusion, which should be confirmed by FISH or RT-PCR.

61647.recognize_zh: 高倍下左側是一片大型細胞，核圓、染色質細緻、有小核仁、細胞質雙嗜色，右側骨髓則充滿帶鮮紅顆粒的嗜酸性球與成熟顆粒球；未成熟紅系前驅細胞片狀聚集緊鄰大量嗜酸性球，是 PCM1::JAK2 腫瘤的典型組合。
features: Sheet of large immature cells with round nuclei, fine chromatin, small nucleoli and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm (left)
Distinct cell borders within the sheet and sharp interface with adjacent marrow
Adjacent marrow with numerous eosinophils and eosinophilic myelocytes containing bright red granules (right)
Maturing neutrophilic granulocytes and scattered red cells in the background
Bony trabecula at the top of the field
61647.describe_en: High-power view of the bone marrow biopsy shows, on the left, a sheet of large immature cells with round nuclei, fine chromatin, small nucleoli and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm with distinct cell borders. On the right, the adjacent marrow shows maturing granulocytes with numerous eosinophils and eosinophilic precursors containing bright red granules. The immature cell sheets correspond to glycophorin C-positive erythroid precursors on immunostaining. The juxtaposition of expanded immature erythroid islands and marrow eosinophilia is consistent with myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with PCM1::JAK2.

ddx.vs: These share marrow eosinophilia but lack the characteristic immature erythroid islands, and are distinguished by FISH/molecular testing.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with eosinophilia (e.g., CBFB::MYH11)
ddx.vs: AML with inv(16) shows CD34/CD117-positive blasts and abnormal eosinophils with basophilic granules, not glycophorin-positive erythroid sheets.
Mast cell aggregates have spindled or ovoid cells with clear cytoplasm and are tryptase/CD117/CD25 positive.
CEL shows eosinophilia without large erythroid islands and lacks a defining tyrosine kinase fusion.

61583.recognize_zh: 老年病人胸腹部全景，前胸至下腹廣泛散布數百個紅紫色丘疹與結節，較大者呈光滑圓頂狀；這種全身性多發浸潤性皮膚結節在白血病病人提示 leukemia cutis。
features: Widespread symmetric eruption of hundreds of red-violet papules and nodules over the chest and abdomen
