Lesion size ranges from 1–2 mm papules to nodules about 1 cm with smooth shiny domes
No ulceration, scale or grouped vesicles; non-dermatomal distribution
Elderly patient with a healed midline sternotomy-type scar
61583.describe_en: Clinical photograph of the anterior chest and abdomen of an elderly patient shows a widespread, non-dermatomal eruption of innumerable red-violet papules and larger smooth dome-shaped nodules up to approximately 1 cm, without ulceration or scale. The extent and nodular character of the lesions indicate a dermal infiltrative process. In the setting of acute myeloid leukemia this is suggestive of leukemia cutis; skin biopsy is required for confirmation.

ddx.dx: Disseminated cutaneous lymphoma (e.g. primary cutaneous DLBCL, leg type, or systemic lymphoma)
ddx.vs: Clinically indistinguishable; biopsy showing CD20+ B cells rather than MPO/CD33/CD68+ myeloid cells separates them.
BPDCN classically presents with bruise-like violaceous skin nodules in older men, but biopsy blasts are CD4+, CD56+, CD123+, TCF4+ and MPO−.
Cherry angiomas are bright red, soft, compressible papules that are stable over time, not rapidly appearing infiltrated nodules.
Metastases are usually fewer, firm flesh-colored to red nodules, and biopsy shows cytokeratin-positive epithelial cells.

61519.recognize_zh: 箭頭指出的兩顆細胞是有核紅血球（NRBC）：核小而圓、染色質濃縮深染，外圍有一圈灰藍到淡粉紅的細胞質，大小接近紅血球；背景紅血球多呈圓鋸齒狀，並散佈粉紫色顆粒狀沉澱，染色品質欠佳。
features: Two arrowed nucleated red cells with small, round, dense pyknotic nuclei and a rim of pale gray to pink cytoplasm
NRBC size comparable to or slightly larger than surrounding red cells, consistent with orthochromatic normoblasts
Background red cells show crenation (echinocytic change) and variable size
Some red cells show increased central pallor
Abundant pink-purple granular stain precipitate or platelet debris in the background; suboptimal staining quality
61519.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two nucleated red cells (arrows) with small, round, dense nuclei and a rim of gray to pink cytoplasm, consistent with orthochromatic normoblasts. The background red cells show anisocytosis, some increased central pallor, and diffuse crenation that likely reflects slide preparation artifact. Abundant granular precipitate limits evaluation of platelets and fine red cell inclusions. When NRBCs are this numerous (130 per 100 WBC in this case), automated leukocyte counts must be corrected, and the combination of hypochromia and target cells should prompt evaluation for thalassemia major/intermedia, hemolysis, or marrow infiltration.

ddx.vs: Lymphocytes have a larger nucleus with clumped but not homogeneously pyknotic chromatin and a scant sky-blue cytoplasm, rather than the pink hemoglobinized cytoplasm of normoblasts.
Thalassemia is suggested by microcytic hypochromic red cells with abundant target cells, basophilic stippling, and NRBCs, and is confirmed by hemoglobin HPLC.
A leukoerythroblastic reaction adds immature granulocytes and teardrop cells to circulating NRBCs.

ddx.dx: Stain precipitate or platelet clumps overlying red cells
ddx.vs: Precipitate is refractile and lies in a different focal plane without a defined cytoplasmic rim.

61455.recognize_zh: A 圖 CellaVision 自動影像只抓到桿狀/分葉嗜中性球、單核球與骨髓細胞，沒有母細胞；但 B 圖 Sysmex WDF 散佈圖上方有高側向螢光（SFL）的異常族群（紅圈），而 C、D 圖在抹片羽狀緣與側緣找到大量巨大母細胞，說明大細胞會被推到抹片邊緣而被自動系統漏掉。
features: Panel A: CellaVision gallery shows band and segmented neutrophils, myelocytes, metamyelocytes, lymphocytes, and monocytes, without blasts
Panel B: Sysmex WDF scattergram (SFL vs SSC) with a discrete high side-fluorescence population (dotted circle) above the normal clusters
Panel C: feathered edge of the smear with clusters of very large cells with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin, and basophilic cytoplasm (blasts), some with vacuoles
Panel D: lateral edge of the smear with isolated large blasts
Monocytosis and left-shifted granulocytes in the reading area
61455.describe_en: Composite figure. Automated digital morphology of the smear body (A) shows left-shifted neutrophils, myelocytes, and monocytes without blasts, whereas the analyzer WDF scattergram (B) displays an abnormal population with high side fluorescence consistent with cells of high nucleic acid content. Manual review of the feathered (C) and lateral (D) edges reveals numerous very large blasts with high N:C ratios, fine chromatin, and basophilic, occasionally vacuolated cytoplasm. The discordance reflects preferential displacement of large cells to the smear edges, beyond the area sampled by the automated imager. Findings are suspicious for acute leukemia (confirmed as AML on marrow) and illustrate the need to scan smear edges when flags and images disagree.

ddx.vs: A leukemoid reaction shows a full spectrum of maturing granulocytes without a discrete blast population on the edges or a high-SFL cluster.
Reactive lymphocytes also flag as abnormal lymphocytes but have abundant cytoplasm hugging RBCs and more condensed chromatin than blasts.
Smudge cells lack intact cytoplasm and nuclear detail and do not form a coherent high-SFL population.

ddx.dx: Carcinoma or lymphoma cells in blood
ddx.vs: Cohesive clusters of large cells can mimic blasts, so flow cytometry is needed to establish myeloid blast lineage.

61391.recognize_zh: 中倍 H&E 可見血管腔內充滿均質粉紅色的血栓（左側一條長形、中央一個圓形），周圍被許多卵圓至腎形核的上皮樣組織球包圍，下方另有兩顆大型多葉核的不典型細胞，符合 EBV 陽性黏膜皮膚潰瘍中常見的血管栓塞與組織球反應。
features: Small vessels with lumina occluded by homogeneous eosinophilic thrombus material
Surrounding plump epithelioid histiocytes with oval to reniform nuclei, fine chromatin and pale cytoplasm
Two large atypical cells with multilobated, hyperchromatic nuclei in the lower field
Scattered small lymphocytes and occasional apoptotic bodies
Fibrillary to edematous eosinophilic stroma at right
61391.describe_en: Sections show small vessels whose lumina are occluded by homogeneous eosinophilic thrombi, surrounded and infiltrated by numerous epithelioid histiocytes with oval to kidney-shaped nuclei. Scattered small lymphocytes and apoptotic bodies are present, and two large atypical cells with multilobated hyperchromatic nuclei are seen in the lower field. Well-formed granulomas and organisms are not identified. Vascular thrombosis with perivascular histiocytic reaction and scattered atypical large cells is a recognized feature of EBV-positive mucocutaneous ulcer and should prompt EBER in situ hybridization.

ddx.vs: Shows true angiocentric infiltration of vessel walls by EBV+ large B cells with fibrinoid necrosis, usually in lung, rather than luminal thrombi within a circumscribed mucocutaneous ulcer.
Angiodestructive growth with coagulative necrosis by atypical medium-sized cells that are CD56+ and cytoplasmic CD3+, with EBER in the neoplastic T/NK cells rather than B cells.
Features necrotizing vasculitis with geographic basophilic necrosis, multinucleated giant cells and ANCA positivity, without EBER-positive atypical B cells.

61327.recognize_zh: CD21 染色顯示濾泡樹突細胞（FDC）網狀結構大片擴張、呈不規則分枝，延伸到濾泡外並包圍血管，而不是局限於圓形生發中心，這種失序擴張的 FDC 網是血管免疫母細胞性 T 細胞淋巴瘤的特徵。
features: Extensive, irregular CD21-positive follicular dendritic cell meshworks outside of follicles
Arborizing FDC networks wrapping around small vessels (high endothelial venules)
Loss of discrete, round follicular architecture
Intervening sheets of CD21-negative lymphoid cells
No well-formed primary or secondary follicles identified in this field
61327.describe_en: CD21 immunostain of the lymph node shows markedly expanded, irregular follicular dendritic cell meshworks that extend diffusely through the paracortex rather than forming discrete round follicles. The meshworks arborize and encircle numerous small vessels consistent with high endothelial venules. Intervening lymphoid cells are CD21-negative. This pattern of extrafollicular FDC proliferation is characteristic of angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma (pattern 3) and should be correlated with TFH markers (PD-1, CXCL13, ICOS, BCL6) and T-cell clonality studies.

ddx.vs: Reactive FDC meshworks are compact and confined to round germinal centers without extrafollicular extension around vessels.
FL shows CD21 meshworks within back-to-back neoplastic follicles containing CD10+/BCL2+ B cells, not perivascular arborization among T cells.
PTCL-NOS lacks expanded extrafollicular FDC meshworks and lacks a full TFH immunophenotype.
Castleman disease has regressed follicles with concentric FDC meshworks and penetrating hyalinized vessels, without atypical TFH cells.

61263.recognize_zh: 周邊血高倍下單一顆母細胞，核大、染色質細緻，核的一側有深凹陷，淡染的細胞質嵌入凹陷中形成杯狀核（cup-like nucleus），淡藍的細胞質裡可見一條細長的紅紫色棒狀物（Auer rod）；杯狀核母細胞是 NPM1 突變 AML 的形態線索。
features: Single large blast, about 1.5-2 times the diameter of adjacent red cells
Nucleus with a deep invagination occupied by pale cytoplasm, producing a cup-like (fish-mouth) appearance
Finely dispersed chromatin with faint nucleoli; high N:C ratio
Pale blue, largely agranular cytoplasm containing a slender rod-shaped inclusion consistent with an Auer rod
Surrounding red cells unremarkable; a small platelet clump at left
61263.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a circulating blast with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin and a prominent nuclear invagination filled with pale cytoplasm, imparting a cup-like morphology. The pale blue cytoplasm contains a slender rod-shaped inclusion consistent with an Auer rod, confirming myeloid lineage. Cup-like blasts are associated with NPM1 mutation, often together with FLT3-ITD, but molecular testing is required for classification. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with cup-like blasts, in keeping with AML with mutated NPM1.

ddx.vs: Shows bilobed, butterfly-shaped nuclei with multiple Auer rods and fine granules rather than a single cup-shaped invagination; confirmed by PML::RARA.

ddx.dx: AML with FLT3-ITD without NPM1 mutation
ddx.vs: Cup-like blasts can occur, so NPM1 mutation analysis (or cytoplasmic NPM1 IHC) is required rather than morphology alone.
Promonocytes have delicately folded nuclei and abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with fine granules, with NSE positivity and usually no Auer rods.
Has condensed chromatin without nucleoli and never contains Auer rods.

61199.recognize_zh: 左側有一顆比旁邊紅血球還大的血小板，含紫紅色顆粒與淡藍色周邊細胞質，右側另有一顆較小的血小板可對照，屬於巨大血小板，符合 Bernard-Soulier 症候群。
features: Giant platelet larger than adjacent red cells, with central purple granules and pale blue peripheral hyalomere
A smaller platelet at right for size comparison
Overlapping normochromic red cells in a thick area of the smear
Low image resolution limits assessment of granule detail
61199.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normochromic red cells, some overlapping in a thicker area. A giant platelet exceeding the diameter of adjacent red cells is present, with central granules and a pale blue hyalomere, alongside a smaller platelet. Image resolution is limited. Findings are consistent with macrothrombocytopenia, supporting Bernard-Soulier syndrome in the appropriate clinical and laboratory context.

ddx.vs: MYH9 disorders show Dohle-like neutrophil inclusions and normal ristocetin-induced platelet aggregation.
ITP platelets are usually only mildly enlarged and GPIb-IX expression is normal.

ddx.dx: Overlapping platelet on a lymphocyte or small cell fragment
ddx.vs: A platelet lying on another cell shows a nucleus or two focal planes, whereas this is a single granular body without a nucleus.

61135.recognize_zh: 淋巴結結構被單一型態、中等大小的細胞取代，高倍下核圓偏位、染色質細、細胞質淡紫紅色呈漿細胞樣（plasmacytoid），多種免疫染色呈大片陽性而增殖指標只有散在少數陽性，符合成熟漿細胞樣樹突細胞增生。
features: Low power (A): diffuse, relatively uniform infiltrate effacing nodal architecture
Medium power (B): monotonous sheets of medium-sized cells around small vessels
High power (C): medium-sized cells with round, eccentric nuclei, fine to slightly condensed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and moderate amphophilic plasmacytoid cytoplasm
No significant pleomorphism or brisk mitotic activity evident
IHC (D-F): diffuse strong staining of the sheets for the plasmacytoid dendritic cell markers shown
IHC (G): only scattered nuclear-positive cells, consistent with a low proliferation index; double stains (H, I) show the brown-positive population with admixed red-labeled cells
61135.describe_en: Composite figure of a lymph node from a patient with chronic myelomonocytic leukemia. The nodal architecture is effaced by diffuse, monotonous sheets of medium-sized cells with round eccentric nuclei, finely condensed chromatin and moderate amphophilic plasmacytoid cytoplasm, lacking significant atypia. Immunostains show diffuse positivity of the infiltrate for the plasmacytoid dendritic cell markers displayed, while a nuclear proliferation marker labels only scattered cells; double stains highlight the dominant population with an admixed minor second population. Findings are consistent with an exuberant nodal proliferation of mature plasmacytoid dendritic cells associated with a myeloid neoplasm (CMML).

ddx.vs: BPDCN cells are blastic with fine chromatin and high proliferation, typically involve skin, and are CD56 and TdT variably positive, whereas mature pDC proliferations are CD56 negative with low Ki-67.
Monocytic myeloid sarcoma shows folded nuclei and expresses lysozyme/CD163/CD14 rather than CD123/TCL1 with a low proliferation index.
B-cell lymphomas with plasmacytic features express CD20/PAX5 and light-chain restriction rather than CD123, CD303 and TCL1.
Plasma cells have clockface chromatin and a hof and are CD138 positive with monotypic light chains.

61071.recognize_zh: 影像組合包含右心房周圍浸潤腫塊、雙側腎周軟組織包覆（hairy kidney）、股骨遠端骨幹骨硬化與骨掃描雙側膝部對稱性攝取增加；組織學為富含淡染泡沫狀細胞質的組織球（箭頭），這些多系統表現合起來即 Erdheim-Chester 病。
features: MRI (A): soft-tissue mass infiltrating the right atrial wall/atrioventricular groove region (arrow), explaining conduction disturbance
CT (B): bilateral perirenal soft-tissue infiltration encasing the kidneys (hairy kidney appearance)
Radiograph (C): patchy sclerosis of the distal femoral metadiaphysis sparing the epiphysis
Bone scan (D): bilateral, symmetric increased tracer uptake in the distal femora and proximal tibiae around the knees
Histology (E): histiocytes with abundant pale, finely vacuolated (foamy) cytoplasm and bland small nuclei (arrows) in a fibrotic background with scattered lymphocytes
61071.describe_en: Multimodality imaging demonstrates a right atrial/pericardial infiltrative mass, bilateral perirenal soft-tissue encasement, sclerotic lesions of the distal femoral metadiaphysis, and symmetric increased tracer uptake about both knees on bone scintigraphy. Biopsy shows an infiltrate of histiocytes with abundant pale foamy cytoplasm and bland nuclei (arrows) within fibrous stroma. The immunophenotype is not shown. Together, findings are consistent with Erdheim-Chester disease with cardiac involvement presenting as bradycardia; confirmation with CD68/CD163 positivity, CD1a/langerin negativity and BRAF V600E or MAPK-pathway mutation testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: LCH cells have grooved coffee-bean nuclei, are CD1a/langerin positive, and usually cause lytic rather than symmetric sclerotic long-bone lesions.
RDD histiocytes are S100 positive with emperipolesis and typically involve lymph nodes, lacking symmetric metadiaphyseal sclerosis.
IgG4-RD shows storiform fibrosis, obliterative phlebitis and abundant IgG4+ plasma cells rather than foamy CD68+ histiocytes and bone sclerosis.
These show sheets of atypical CD20+ lymphoid cells or CD31/ERG+ malignant vascular channels rather than bland foamy histiocytes.

61071.stain: H&E; MRI; CT; radiograph; bone scintigraphy

61007.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中顆粒球系為主，數顆成熟嗜中性球細胞質淡粉、幾乎無顆粒（hypogranular），核分葉異常或呈環形／扭曲；上方有一顆周邊充滿粗大深色顆粒的細胞（嗜鹼性球系），整體呈現 aCML 常見的顆粒球發育不良。
features: Predominance of granulocytic precursors: myelocytes and metamyelocytes with round to kidney-shaped nuclei
Several neutrophils with pale, hypogranular cytoplasm and abnormal nuclear segmentation (twisted/ring-like, hyposegmented forms)
Upper-center cell with coarse dark basophilic granules concentrated at the periphery (basophil lineage)
Occasional small dark erythroid precursor and a larger cell with blue cytoplasm and eccentric nucleus
Background of platelets and granular debris overlying red cells
61007.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a granulocyte-predominant population of myelocytes, metamyelocytes and neutrophils. Several mature neutrophils display hypogranular pale cytoplasm and abnormal nuclear segmentation, including twisted/ring-like and hyposegmented forms, consistent with dysgranulopoiesis. A cell with coarse dark basophilic granules is present at the top of the field, and scattered erythroid precursors are seen. No increase in blasts is apparent in this field. The findings of granulocytic predominance with dysgranulopoiesis are consistent with atypical CML in the appropriate BCR::ABL1-negative context.

ddx.vs: CML granulocytes are normally granulated without dysplasia, with prominent basophils/eosinophils and dwarf megakaryocytes; BCR::ABL1 separates them.
MDS shows similar dysgranulopoiesis but with peripheral cytopenias rather than neutrophilic leukocytosis.
CMML shows increased monocytes and promonocytes, confirmed by nonspecific esterase and blood monocytosis.
Reactive marrows show normally granulated neutrophils with toxic granulation rather than hypogranular, abnormally segmented forms.

60943.recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結被密集的背靠背結節取代，結節內充滿淡粉紅色無結構的細胞外沉積物，腫瘤細胞散在其中；免疫染色中沉積物呈強棕色、腫瘤細胞核與膜陽性，提示濾泡性淋巴瘤合併細胞外嗜伊紅物質沉積的罕見變異型。
features: Low power: effacement of lymph node by numerous closely packed nodules (follicular pattern)
Nodules filled with pale eosinophilic, amorphous extracellular material separating neoplastic cells
Neoplastic cells within nodules: centrocyte/centroblast-like cells with irregular nuclei; darker small lymphocytes between nodules
IHC panel D: intense staining of the extracellular deposits within follicles (antigen not labeled)
IHC panel E: nuclear staining of intrafollicular cells (germinal center marker such as BCL6 or proliferation marker)
IHC panel F: diffuse strong staining of lymphoid cells (e.g., B-cell marker/BCL2)
60943.describe_en: Lymph node sections show effacement of architecture by numerous back-to-back neoplastic follicles. The follicles are expanded by pale eosinophilic, acellular amorphous material in which neoplastic follicle center cells are dispersed, while interfollicular areas contain small dark lymphocytes. Immunostains show intense staining of the intrafollicular deposits in one panel, nuclear positivity of intrafollicular cells in another, and diffuse strong lymphoid staining in a third; antigens are not labeled in the figure. In the context of the stated diagnosis, findings are consistent with follicular lymphoma with intrafollicular extracellular eosinophilic (proteinaceous) deposits, a rare histologic variant; Congo red and immunoglobulin stains help characterize the material.

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles are polarized with tingible-body macrophages, a mantle zone and BCL2-negative germinal centers, rather than back-to-back BCL2+ nodules.

ddx.dx: Nodal amyloidoma / AL amyloidosis with lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma
ddx.vs: Amyloid is Congo red positive with apple-green birefringence and often deposited around vessels in a plasmacytic background rather than confined to neoplastic follicles.

ddx.dx: Nodular sclerosis or nodular lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma
ddx.vs: Hodgkin nodules contain scattered CD30/CD15 or CD20+ LP cells in a reactive background instead of sheets of CD10/BCL6+ neoplastic centrocytes.
Castleman follicles show regressed germinal centers with penetrating hyalinized vessels and onion-skin mantles, not amorphous intrafollicular deposits.

60879.recognize_zh: 兩個偏心核細胞並排：上方較小的細胞核染色質粗塊狀、深染（車輪狀），胞質深藍，是漿細胞；下方較大的細胞核染色質較細緻、胞質淡藍呈雲絮狀且邊界模糊，核看起來幾乎被擠出細胞外，是骨母細胞（osteoblast）。
features: Two adjacent cells with eccentric round nuclei in a fatty, hemodilute background
Upper cell (plasma cell): smaller, dense coarsely clumped 'clock-face' chromatin, compact deep blue cytoplasm
Lower cell (osteoblast): larger oval nucleus with finer, more evenly distributed chromatin, positioned at the cell edge as if partially extruded
Osteoblast cytoplasm pale-to-medium blue, abundant, wispy with ill-defined borders and small vacuoles
Perinuclear clear (Golgi) zone not well seen in either cell in this field
60879.describe_en: Wright-Giemsa-stained bone marrow aspirate smear shows two cells with eccentrically placed nuclei. The upper, smaller cell has condensed, coarsely clumped chromatin and compact deep blue cytoplasm, typical of a plasma cell. The lower, larger cell has a round-to-oval nucleus with finer chromatin that appears partially extruded at the cell margin and abundant pale blue, wispy cytoplasm with indistinct borders, typical of an osteoblast. This comparison illustrates the chromatin pattern and cytoplasmic features that separate plasma cells from osteoblasts.

ddx.vs: Osteoclasts are giant multinucleated cells with many separate uniform nuclei and granular cytoplasm, unlike the single eccentric nucleus of an osteoblast.

Myeloma cells may show immature open chromatin and nucleoli, but they occur in sheets or increased numbers and lack the ill-defined wispy cytoplasm and extruded nucleus of osteoblasts; CD138 and light-chain restriction confirm.
Carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters with nuclear pleomorphism and prominent nucleoli, whereas osteoblasts occur in loose groups with bland uniform nuclei.

60815.recognize_zh: CD20 染色在大型、核仁明顯的非典型細胞呈清楚的膜狀棕色陽性，背景小淋巴球與右下角的細長細胞為陰性，表示大細胞為 B 細胞來源，符合 EBV 陽性黏膜皮膚潰瘍的免疫表型。
features: Strong membranous CD20 staining outlining large atypical cells with vesicular nuclei
Positive cells vary in size, including very large Hodgkin-like forms
Granular brown staining also present in background, partly from membrane fragments
Negative small lymphocytes and spindle/endothelial-like cells (lower right)
60815.describe_en: CD20 immunohistochemistry shows strong membranous staining of numerous large atypical cells with vesicular nuclei, some reaching Hodgkin-like size, together with a proportion of smaller positive cells. Admixed small lymphocytes and stromal cells in the lower right are negative. The large cells are therefore B cells, supporting EBV-positive mucocutaneous ulcer when combined with EBER positivity and the ulcer architecture.

ddx.vs: HRS cells are CD20 negative or weak and variable, while the large cells here show strong uniform membranous CD20.

ddx.dx: EBV-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS
ddx.vs: Also CD20+ large cells but forms a monotonous sheet or mass rather than a circumscribed ulcer with polymorphous background.
Has few scattered CD20+ large cells in a histiocyte-rich background and is typically EBER negative.

60751.recognize_zh: 組圖 A 切片為片狀中型非典型淋巴細胞、核不規則深染；B–D 免疫染色分別呈強細胞膜/細胞質、膜狀與細胞質顆粒狀陽性（符合 NK 細胞表型與細胞毒性顆粒）；E 小圖抹片細胞核圓或分葉、細胞質含嗜天青顆粒，配合 EBV 陽性即為侵襲性 NK 細胞白血病。
features: Panel A (H&E): diffuse infiltrate of medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with irregular hyperchromatic nuclei, scant to moderate pale cytoplasm and scattered apoptotic cells
Panel B (IHC): strong membranous/cytoplasmic staining in nearly all tumor cells
Panel C (IHC): moderate membranous staining in a diffuse population
Panel D (IHC): coarse granular cytoplasmic staining in a subset of cells, consistent with a cytotoxic granule marker
Panel E (smear inset): large atypical cells with round to lobulated nuclei, fine chromatin and pale cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules
Specific antibodies in B-D are not labeled in the figure
60751.describe_en: Composite figure: tissue section (A) shows a diffuse infiltrate of medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with irregular hyperchromatic nuclei and scattered apoptotic cells. Immunohistochemical stains (B-D, antibodies not labeled in the image) show diffuse strong membranous/cytoplasmic positivity, diffuse membranous positivity and granular cytoplasmic positivity, respectively, the latter pattern typical of cytotoxic granule proteins. The smear inset (E) shows atypical large lymphoid cells with round to lobulated nuclei and azurophilic cytoplasmic granules. In a patient with fever, jaundice, cytopenias and EBV positivity, findings are consistent with EBV-associated aggressive NK-cell leukemia.

ddx.dx: Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma with leukemic dissemination
ddx.vs: Shares the CD56+/cytotoxic/EBER+ phenotype but presents with a nasal or extranodal mass and angiocentric necrosis; clinical distribution rather than morphology separates them.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells
ddx.vs: Cells are small, mature large granular lymphocytes with an indolent course and are EBV negative.
Shows sinusoidal infiltration by monotonous gamma-delta T cells that are EBV negative with isochromosome 7q.
Lacks a clonal/atypical NK-cell infiltrate, showing instead reactive lymphocytes and hemophagocytic histiocytes.

60623.recognize_zh: 縱膈腫塊切片同時有兩個區域：左上為結節硬化型何杰金淋巴瘤（NSHL），CD30 染出散在大型 Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg 細胞；右下為密集單一樣的骨髓肉瘤（myeloid sarcoma），骨髓標記瀰漫陽性，FISH 顯示腫瘤細胞紅綠訊號分離（基因重組）。
features: Low power H&E: two juxtaposed areas labeled NSHL and myeloid sarcoma, the latter a dense sheet of monotonous cells
CD30 immunostain: scattered large cells with membranous and Golgi-dot staining in a background of small non-staining lymphocytes (Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells)
Diffuse granular cytoplasmic staining of the sheet-like infiltrate with a myeloid marker in panel C
Interphase FISH with a break-apart probe: one nucleus with two fused (yellow) signals and a larger nucleus with separated red and green signals, indicating rearrangement
60623.describe_en: Sections of the mediastinal mass (H&E) show two distinct components: one with a mixed inflammatory background containing scattered large atypical cells, and an adjacent area composed of diffuse sheets of monotonous intermediate-sized cells. CD30 highlights scattered large Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells in the first component, whereas the sheet-like infiltrate shows diffuse positivity for a myeloid marker. Break-apart FISH demonstrates split signals in tumor nuclei, indicating a gene rearrangement. Findings are consistent with relapsed nodular sclerosis classic Hodgkin lymphoma with a synchronous therapy-related myeloid sarcoma in the same mass.

ddx.dx: Syncytial variant of nodular sclerosis Hodgkin lymphoma
ddx.vs: Syncytial cHL sheets are composed of CD30+/CD15+ Reed-Sternberg cells, whereas myeloid sarcoma sheets are CD30-negative and express MPO/CD33/lysozyme.
ALCL shows sheets of CD30-positive hallmark cells with strong uniform CD30 and often ALK, unlike the myeloid-marker-positive sheet here.
PMBL sheets express CD20/PAX5 strongly with compartmentalizing sclerosis and lack myeloid markers.

ddx.dx: Thymic carcinoma or germ cell tumor
ddx.vs: Epithelial and germ cell tumors are keratin, SALL4 or OCT3/4 positive rather than myeloid markers.

60623.stain: H&E; IHC: CD30, myeloid marker; FISH

60687.recognize_zh: Romanowsky 染色下漿細胞質內充滿大小不一的淡藍色圓形包涵體（Russell 小體，Mott 細胞）；同一類細胞在 Papanicolaou 染色則呈現鮮明的橘色圓球，是 Russell 小體在巴氏染色的特徵顏色。
features: Panel A: plasma cells with eccentric, sometimes binucleated nuclei and deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Panel A: numerous small round pale-blue to clear globular inclusions distending the cytoplasm and cytoplasmic blebs (Russell bodies, Mott cell pattern)
Panels Bi and Bii (Papanicolaou): cells containing multiple round, refractile, orange-colored globules of varying size packing the cytoplasm
Inclusions are homogeneous and sharply demarcated, consistent with condensed immunoglobulin
Adjacent cells in Bii without inclusions for comparison
60687.describe_en: The Romanowsky-stained preparation shows plasma cells, including a binucleated form, with deeply basophilic cytoplasm filled with multiple round pale globular inclusions, consistent with Mott cells containing Russell bodies. On Papanicolaou staining, similar cells contain numerous sharply circumscribed, homogeneous orange globules. Recognizing the orange color of Russell bodies on Pap stain prevents misinterpretation as pigment, mucin or microorganisms. Findings are consistent with plasma cells containing Russell bodies (Mott cells), which can occur in reactive plasmacytosis or plasma cell neoplasms.

ddx.vs: Hemosiderin is coarse golden-brown and irregular in macrophages with Prussian blue positivity, rather than uniform round orange globules in plasma cells.
Signet-ring cells have a single large mucin vacuole displacing the nucleus and are cytokeratin positive, not multiple small immunoglobulin globules.
Dutcher bodies are single intranuclear pseudoinclusions overlying the nucleus rather than multiple cytoplasmic globules.
Yeasts have a cell wall, budding and variable staining, and are often extracellular, unlike homogeneous intracytoplasmic globules.

60559.recognize_zh: 紅色箭頭所指的多染性（偏藍）紅血球內，可見沿細胞邊緣彎繞的紫色細線環（Cabot ring）；藍色箭頭指向同一細胞邊緣的深色小圓點，為 Howell-Jolly 小體。
features: Polychromatic, slightly bluish red cell containing a thin violet curved ring inclusion along its periphery (red arrow)
Small, dense, dark round inclusion at the cell margin consistent with a Howell-Jolly body (blue arrow)
Small central clear area within the same cell
Surrounding red cells show anisocytosis and mild poikilocytosis with irregular contours
No leukocytes or parasites in this field
60559.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows red cells with anisocytosis and mild poikilocytosis. A polychromatic red cell contains a thin, curved, violet-staining ring-like thread tracing its periphery, consistent with a Cabot ring, and a small dense round basophilic inclusion at its edge consistent with a Howell-Jolly body. No intraerythrocytic parasites are identified. Findings are consistent with a Cabot ring and Howell-Jolly body, reflecting stressed erythropoiesis in hemolytic anemia.

ddx.vs: A falciparum ring is a delicate blue loop with one or two red chromatin dots often in normal-colored cells, whereas a Cabot ring is a violet thread hugging the membrane and the Howell-Jolly body is a separate, larger dense dot.
Pappenheimer bodies are multiple fine peripheral granules that stain with Prussian blue, unlike this single round Howell-Jolly body.
Basophilic stippling consists of numerous fine or coarse granules dispersed throughout the cell rather than a single thread and a single dot.

60495.recognize_zh: 四格組合圖：(A) 血液抹片中一顆細胞質豐富、含紫紅色嗜天青顆粒的大顆粒淋巴球；(B, C) 骨髓凝塊切片可見多個小淋巴球聚集；(D) CD3 染色顯示這些聚集主要為 T 細胞，符合 T 細胞大顆粒淋巴球白血病。
features: Panel A: large granular lymphocyte with round slightly eccentric nucleus, condensed chromatin, and moderate pale cytoplasm containing coarse azurophilic granules
Panel B: low-power bone marrow aspirate particle section with several dense lymphoid aggregates
Panel C: aggregate composed of monotonous small round lymphocytes with condensed chromatin
Panel D: CD3 immunostain strongly highlights the aggregates and scattered interstitial T cells
Background red cells in panel A unremarkable; no blasts seen
60495.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (A) shows a large granular lymphocyte with a round nucleus, condensed chromatin, and moderate pale cytoplasm containing coarse azurophilic granules. The bone marrow aspirate particle section (B) contains multiple lymphoid aggregates that at higher power (C) are composed predominantly of small, mature-appearing lymphocytes. CD3 immunohistochemistry (D) highlights numerous T cells within the aggregates and in the interstitium. Findings are consistent with T-cell large granular lymphocytic leukemia in the appropriate clinical context (persistent LGL count, clonal TCR rearrangement, STAT3 mutation, and CD8/CD57/TIA-1 or granzyme B intrasinusoidal clusters).

ddx.dx: Reactive LGL expansion (viral infection, post-transplant, autoimmune)
ddx.vs: Reactive expansions are usually transient and polyclonal without a clonal TCR rearrangement, STAT3 mutation, or intrasinusoidal linear cytotoxic T-cell clusters.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells
ddx.vs: NK-LGL cells are surface CD3 negative, CD56 positive, with no TCR rearrangement.
Aggressive NK-cell leukemia shows atypical larger cells with nucleoli, EBV positivity, and a fulminant clinical course rather than indolent cytopenias.
Benign aggregates are small, well-circumscribed, non-paratrabecular, and mixed B/T without a clonal cytotoxic T-cell population.

60431.recognize_zh: 低倍 CD21 免疫染色把整個淋巴結染出許多大而圓、邊界清楚、緊密排列的棕色結節，每一結節內都是擴大的濾泡樹突細胞（FDC）網，結節之間為陰性區；這種大量、擴大的 FDC 網狀大結節即結節性淋巴球為主型霍奇金淋巴瘤（NLPHL）的結節結構。
features: CD21 immunostain at low power highlighting numerous large, round to irregular, closely packed nodules
Each nodule contains an expanded, dense follicular dendritic cell meshwork with sharp to slightly frayed borders
Some nodules show a speckled pattern of small unstained holes within the meshwork (entrapped cells)
CD21-negative internodular zones between the nodules
Nodules replace most of the lymph node, with no normal-sized follicle pattern
60431.describe_en: CD21 immunohistochemistry at low magnification highlights numerous large, expanded follicular dendritic cell meshworks forming closely packed nodules that replace most of the lymph node. The meshworks are dense and well-delineated, with small unstained spaces corresponding to entrapped lymphocytes and LP cells, separated by CD21-negative internodular areas. This macronodular pattern of expanded FDC networks is characteristic of nodular lymphocyte predominant Hodgkin lymphoma (nodular lymphocyte predominant B-cell lymphoma in newer classification), typical pattern A/B.

ddx.vs: FL nodules are more numerous, smaller and back-to-back with CD10+/BCL2+ neoplastic centrocytes, rather than large nodules of small B cells containing scattered LP cells.
PTGC produces only a few enlarged nodules within an otherwise reactive node, whereas here nodules efface most of the architecture and contain LP cells.
Nodular LRCHL also has CD21+ meshworks, but the large cells are CD30+/CD15+ HRS cells located in expanded mantle zones, often with residual regressed germinal centers.
THRLBCL shows a diffuse pattern with loss of FDC meshworks, so extensive nodular CD21 staining argues against it.

60367.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中可見三顆小至中型母細胞，核質比極高、染色質細緻、細胞質只剩一圈嗜鹼性邊緣且無顆粒，同視野沒有嗜中性球，提示循環中的淋巴母細胞。
features: Three circulating blasts, small to intermediate in size (about 1.5-2x a red cell)
Very high N:C ratio with only a thin rim of basophilic agranular cytoplasm
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with fine, evenly dispersed chromatin; nucleoli not conspicuous
No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules
Red cells largely normochromic without significant poikilocytosis; no neutrophils or platelets clearly seen in this field
60367.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows scattered circulating blasts that are small to intermediate in size with a very high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and a scant rim of agranular basophilic cytoplasm. No Auer rods are identified. Red cells show no significant morphologic abnormality, and no neutrophils are present in this field. The blasts are morphologically consistent with lymphoblasts; flow cytometry is required for lineage assignment and, in this case, supports B-lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes have more abundant cytoplasm that scallops around red cells and condensed rather than fine blastic chromatin.
Myeloblasts often show more cytoplasm, visible nucleoli, granules or Auer rods, but agranular forms require flow cytometry to separate.
CLL cells have coarse, clumped 'soccer-ball' chromatin and are accompanied by smudge cells rather than fine blastic chromatin.

60175.recognize_zh: 抽吸抹片中這顆巨核細胞體積偏小，胞質呈細顆粒狀，但只有一個圓形、完全不分葉的細胞核（hypolobated/monolobated），與正常多葉的巨核細胞不同，屬於巨核細胞發育不良。
features: Small megakaryocyte, only about two to three times the size of adjacent cells
Single round, non-lobated eccentric nucleus with dense chromatin and a pale perinuclear area
Moderate amount of finely granular, lilac cytoplasm with platelet-type granularity
Two crushed/smudged nuclei abut the cell on the left; background shows stromal strands and scattered platelets
No blasts in this field
60175.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a small megakaryocyte with moderate finely granular cytoplasm and a single round, non-lobated nucleus. Two smudged nuclei lie adjacent, and the background contains stromal strands with scattered platelets. No blasts are identified in this field. The hypolobated small megakaryocyte represents megakaryocytic dysplasia; in a cytopenic patient with ≥10% dysplastic megakaryocytes and no excess blasts, the findings are consistent with myelodysplastic syndrome with single lineage dysplasia.

ddx.vs: Immature megakaryocytes have basophilic agranular cytoplasm and open chromatin, whereas this cell has mature granular cytoplasm with a non-lobated nucleus, indicating dysplastic maturation.
del(5q) megakaryocytes are also mono- or hypolobated but are typically normal-sized to large and increased, with macrocytic anemia and thrombocytosis; karyotype confirms.
CML 'dwarf' megakaryocytes are small and hypolobated but occur in a markedly granulocytic, basophil-rich marrow with BCR::ABL1.
Plasma cells have basophilic cytoplasm with a perinuclear hof and clock-face chromatin, and histiocytes have vacuolated cytoplasm, neither showing fine platelet-type granules.

60111.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 CD34 免疫染色幾乎全為藍色背景，只有零星單顆細胞與小血管內皮呈棕色陽性；提醒 ML-DS 的巨核母細胞常為 CD34 陰性，不能以 CD34 低估芽細胞比例。
features: Cellular marrow with a mixed population of hematopoietic cells, predominantly CD34-negative
Only rare scattered single CD34-positive cells with membranous/cytoplasmic brown staining
Positive staining of small capillary endothelial cells serves as internal control
No clusters or sheets of CD34-positive blasts
60111.describe_en: CD34 immunohistochemical stain of the bone marrow core biopsy shows a cellular marrow in which the vast majority of hematopoietic cells are negative. Only rare scattered CD34-positive cells are present, with no clusters or sheets, and small vessels stain positively as an internal control. Because megakaryoblasts in myeloid leukemia associated with Down syndrome are frequently CD34-negative, this pattern does not exclude an increase in blasts; correlation with aspirate morphology, flow cytometry, and megakaryocytic markers (CD61/CD42b) is required.

ddx.vs: Both show rare CD34-positive cells, so separation relies on aspirate blast count, atypical megakaryocytes, and megakaryocytic marker staining rather than CD34.
Those typically show clusters or sheets of CD34-positive blasts, unlike the rare scattered positivity here.
CD34 may highlight increased vascularity and blasts in fibrotic marrow; reticulin stain and H&E architecture are needed to separate it.

28111.recognize_zh: 血液抹片上可見一條捲曲、體內充滿藍紫色體核（somatic nuclei）的線狀微絲蟲（microfilaria），尾端與頭端外圍有一層粉紅色、延伸超出蟲體的鞘膜（sheath）；配合來自印度孟買的發燒病史，應考慮淋巴絲蟲病（Wuchereria bancrofti 或 Brugia malayi）。
features: Single coiled, elongated microfilaria many times the diameter of a red cell
Column of densely packed, dark blue somatic nuclei filling the body
Pink-staining sheath extending beyond the cephalic and caudal ends of the larva
Distribution of terminal tail nuclei not clearly resolvable in this image
Background of lysed/thick-film material with scattered leukocyte nuclei
28111.describe_en: Stained blood film (thick-film background with lysed erythrocytes) shows a single coiled microfilaria with a column of densely packed somatic nuclei and a pink-staining sheath projecting beyond the ends of the organism. Scattered leukocyte nuclei are present in the background. The tail nuclear pattern needed for species identification cannot be reliably assessed at this resolution. Findings are consistent with a sheathed microfilaria of lymphatic filariasis (Wuchereria bancrofti or Brugia malayi) in a patient from India; the pink sheath on Giemsa favors Brugia, and species confirmation requires tail morphology or PCR.

ddx.vs: Loa loa is sheathed but its sheath is unstained on Giemsa, nuclei extend to the tip of the tail, and it occurs in West/Central Africa rather than India.
Mansonella microfilariae are small and unsheathed with a blunt (perstans) or tapered (ozzardi) tail.
W. bancrofti has a faintly staining sheath and no terminal tail nuclei, whereas B. malayi has a bright pink Giemsa-staining sheath and two separate terminal tail nuclei.
Fibers and hyphae lack an organized column of nuclei and a sheath.

25359.recognize_zh: 前臂皮膚散布紅棕色小丘疹，其間出現一條沿搔抓路徑隆起的線狀紅色風團（Darier 徵象）；皮膚切片 CD117 免疫染色可見真皮內密集陽性的肥大細胞，符合皮膚／系統性肥大細胞增生症。
features: Clinical photo: diffuse small red-brown macules/papules on the forearm with a linear urticarial wheal and flare along a stroke line (Darier sign)
Skin biopsy IHC: dense dermal infiltrate of CD117-positive spindled-to-round mast cells
CD117-positive cells extend around adnexal structures and adipose tissue
Scattered CD117-negative inflammatory cells in the background
25359.describe_en: Skin biopsy immunostained for CD117 shows a dense dermal infiltrate of CD117-positive mast cells arranged in sheets and extending into the surrounding soft tissue. The accompanying clinical photograph shows numerous red-brown papules on the forearm with a linear raised erythematous wheal after stroking the skin, a positive Darier sign. Findings are consistent with cutaneous involvement by mastocytosis (urticaria pigmentosa/maculopapular cutaneous mastocytosis); the chronic diarrhea and pruritus warrant evaluation for systemic mastocytosis with serum tryptase, KIT D816V and bone marrow biopsy.

ddx.vs: Dermatographism produces a linear wheal on normal-appearing skin without pigmented lesions or a dense CD117+/tryptase+ mast cell infiltrate.
Histiocytic lesions are CD68/CD163 positive and CD117 and tryptase negative, and stroking does not urticate.

ddx.dx: Reactive mast cell hyperplasia in inflammatory dermatoses
ddx.vs: Reactive increases are sparse and perivascular without sheets, and mast cells lack aberrant CD25/CD2 expression.

2511.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中可見明顯變大的帶狀核中性球（下方，馬蹄形細胞核）與巨大後骨髓球（中央，U 形核），細胞體積約為正常同階段細胞的 1.5–2 倍，染色質相對細緻、核質發育不同步，旁邊前驅細胞也偏大，是巨母細胞性貧血的典型骨髓線索。
features: Giant band neutrophil with a long, horseshoe-shaped nucleus and abundant granular cytoplasm (bottom center)
Giant metamyelocyte with a large U-shaped nucleus and relatively open chromatin (center)
Enlarged myeloid precursors with abundant cytoplasm containing azurophilic granules (nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony)
Large precursors with fine, open chromatin compared with cytoplasmic maturity
Cells are roughly 1.5-2 times the size of adjacent normal cells
2511.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows enlarged granulocytic precursors, including a giant metamyelocyte with a broad U-shaped nucleus and a giant band neutrophil with an elongated horseshoe-shaped nucleus. The precursors display nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, with relatively fine, open chromatin despite mature granulated cytoplasm. Erythroid precursors are not well represented in this field for megaloblastic assessment. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic hematopoiesis, as seen in vitamin B12 or folate deficiency; serum B12, folate, methylmalonic acid and homocysteine should be correlated.

ddx.vs: MDS may show megaloblastoid changes, but typically has hypogranular or pseudo-Pelger neutrophils, dysplastic megakaryocytes and clonal cytogenetics with normal B12/folate.
Morphology is identical; distinction requires medication history and normal vitamin levels.
Normal bands and metamyelocytes are smaller, roughly the size of adjacent segmented neutrophils, with condensed chromatin appropriate to their stage.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with erythroid predominance
ddx.vs: AML shows increased blasts, whereas megaloblastic marrow has a full maturation spectrum with giant forms and no blast excess.

15119.recognize_zh: 四張皮膚照片：A 圖肢體密集紅色斑丘疹（麻疹樣）；B 圖深色皮膚上紫灰色、邊緣隆起的扁平苔蘚樣斑塊；C 圖小腿散在紅色鱗屑性丘疹；D 圖紅斑背景上密集毛囊性小丘疹（毛囊角化樣）。這些都屬於 NIH 慢性移植物抗宿主病皮膚評分中的「紅斑（erythema）」類別。
features: A: dense erythematous maculopapular (morbilliform) eruption on the extremity
B: violaceous, polygonal lichen planus-like plaques with a raised border on darkly pigmented skin
C: scattered erythematous scaly papules and small plaques on the lower leg (papulosquamous)
D: diffuse erythema with numerous monomorphic follicular papules (keratosis pilaris-like)
Clinical photographs only; no histology
15119.describe_en: Composite clinical photographs of cutaneous lesions grouped under the NIH erythema category for chronic graft-versus-host disease scoring. Panel A shows a confluent erythematous maculopapular, morbilliform eruption. Panel B shows violaceous polygonal lichen planus-like plaques with raised borders on pigmented skin. Panel C shows scattered erythematous papulosquamous papules on the lower leg, and panel D shows diffuse erythema with keratosis pilaris-like follicular papules. Of these, lichen planus-like lesions are diagnostic of chronic GVHD, while maculopapular erythema and papulosquamous or follicular lesions are shared with acute GVHD or other conditions and need other supporting features.

ddx.vs: Drug exanthems begin within days to weeks of a new medication and resolve after withdrawal, whereas GVHD rashes track with immunosuppression changes and show interface dermatitis with satellite necrosis.
Viral rashes occur with fever and positive viral PCR and lack lichenoid or sclerotic features.
Morphology is identical, so distinction rests on post-transplant context and other cGVHD organ involvement.
Psoriasis has thick silvery scale on extensor surfaces and pityriasis rosea shows a herald patch with collarette scale, unlike the GVHD papulosquamous pattern.

captions: A: Maculopapular (morbilliform) erythema
B: Lichen planus-like violaceous plaques
C: Papulosquamous erythematous papules on leg
D: Keratosis pilaris-like follicular papules on erythematous skin

11727.recognize_zh: 這是 CSF 流式細胞圖：CD19 陽性 B 細胞表現 FMC7（部分偏陽性移位）、CD23 陰性，這種 FMC7+ CD23- 的組合配合先前 CD5 陽性，是區分被套細胞淋巴瘤與慢性淋巴球白血病（CD23+ FMC7-）的關鍵。
features: CD45 vs SSC: CD45-bright, low side scatter lymphoid gate with about 97% of events
CD19 vs FMC7: CD19-positive B cells show dim to moderate FMC7 expression, with a large fraction crossing into the positive quadrant
CD19 vs CD23: CD19-positive B cells are CD23-negative
Separate CD19-negative population (T cells) negative for FMC7 and CD23
Total events about 5,800
11727.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis of the cerebrospinal fluid gated on CD45-bright lymphocytes shows a predominant CD19-positive B-cell population with partial to dim-moderate FMC7 expression and absent CD23 expression, alongside a minor CD19-negative T-cell population. Together with CD5 co-expression, CD10 negativity and kappa light chain restriction, this CD5+, CD23-, FMC7+ monoclonal B-cell phenotype is characteristic of mantle cell lymphoma involving the CSF; cyclin D1 or t(11;14) confirmation is recommended.

ddx.vs: CLL is CD23-positive and FMC7-negative with dim CD20 and light chain, the reverse of this CD23-negative FMC7-positive profile.

ddx.dx: Atypical CLL / CD5-positive marginal zone lymphoma
ddx.vs: Some CD5+ non-MCL lymphomas are CD23-negative, so cyclin D1/SOX11 immunostaining or CCND1 rearrangement is needed for definitive separation.
Follicular lymphoma is CD10-positive and CD5-negative, unlike this CD5-positive CD10-negative population.

10063.recognize_zh: 這是 VWF multimer 凝膠電泳圖：第 1 型所有大小的 multimer 都在但整體變淡；2A 缺高分子量與中分子量 multimer；2B 只缺最大的高分子量 multimer，要跟正常血漿（NP）比對梯狀條帶。
features: NP (normal plasma): full ladder of VWF multimers from low to highest molecular weight with even intensity
Type 1: all multimer sizes present with normal distribution but uniformly reduced intensity (quantitative deficiency)
Type 2A: loss of high- and intermediate-molecular-weight multimers, with relative excess of low-molecular-weight bands
Type 2B: selective loss of the largest multimers, with intermediate and low bands preserved
Low-resolution gel; satellite-band (triplet) structure cannot be assessed in this image
10063.describe_en: This is a non-morphologic figure showing a von Willebrand factor multimer analysis by SDS-agarose gel electrophoresis with immunoblotting. The normal plasma lane shows a complete ladder extending to the highest molecular weight multimers. The type 1 lane shows a normal multimer distribution with globally decreased intensity, consistent with a partial quantitative deficiency. The type 2A lane lacks high- and intermediate-molecular-weight multimers, while the type 2B lane lacks only the largest multimers. Interpretation requires correlation with VWF:Ag, VWF activity (VWF:RCo/GPIbM), FVIII and, for 2B, low-dose RIPA.

ddx.vs: It shows the same loss of high-molecular-weight multimers as 2B, but the defect lies in platelet GPIbA and is distinguished by platelet-plasma mixing RIPA studies or GP1BA sequencing.

ddx.dx: Acquired von Willebrand syndrome (e.g. aortic stenosis, LVAD, MPN with thrombocytosis)
ddx.vs: It can produce a 2A-like loss of large multimers but occurs without family history and resolves with treatment of the underlying condition.
Both have a normal multimer distribution; 2M has a reduced activity:antigen ratio and 2N a disproportionately low FVIII with defective FVIII binding.
Multimers are essentially undetectable rather than reduced or selectively lost.

3791.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央一顆組織球的空泡化胞質內包著約五顆完整的有核細胞，右側另一團含大量深色小圓核的吞噬體，背景充滿小而成熟的淋巴球，符合慢性淋巴球性白血病（CLL）合併噬血現象（HLH）。
features: Central histiocyte with pale vacuolated cytoplasm engulfing approximately five intact nucleated cells (erythroid/myeloid precursors)
Adjacent cluster of numerous small, dense, round dark nuclei within purple cytoplasm, suggestive of a second histiocyte containing phagocytosed nucleated red cells or lymphocytes
Background dominated by small mature lymphocytes with condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm
Scattered granulocytic precursors, neutrophils and occasional erythroid cells
3791.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows numerous small mature-appearing lymphocytes with condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm, admixed with residual granulocytic and erythroid precursors. A histiocyte with pale vacuolated cytoplasm contains approximately five intact engulfed nucleated hematopoietic cells, and an adjacent aggregate of many small dense round nuclei within cytoplasm suggests further phagocytosis of nucleated cells. The finding of hemophagocytosis is not by itself diagnostic of HLH and must be correlated with HLH-2004 clinical and laboratory criteria (fever, cytopenias, ferritin, triglycerides, fibrinogen, soluble CD25). Findings are consistent with hemophagocytosis in a marrow involved by a small lymphocytic neoplasm such as CLL.

ddx.vs: In emperipolesis the cells lie within a megakaryocyte with a large lobulated nucleus and granular cytoplasm, rather than within a histiocyte with vacuolated cytoplasm.
Tingible body macrophages contain apoptotic nuclear fragments of variable size rather than intact whole nucleated cells.
Overlapping cells lie in different focal planes without an encircling cytoplasmic rim or phagocytic vacuoles.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell or other small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Background lymphocyte morphology overlaps, so separation from CLL relies on flow cytometry (CD5/CD23/CD200) and cyclin D1 or t(11;14).

3023.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央有一群彼此緊貼、核圓且大小相近、胞質稀少的小圓藍細胞團（cohesive clusters），與周圍散在的造血細胞明顯不同，配合病史符合視網膜母細胞瘤（retinoblastoma）骨髓轉移。
features: Cohesive clusters of small-to-medium round cells with scant pale cytoplasm and high N:C ratio (center and lower left)
Round nuclei with finely granular chromatin, focal nuclear molding and indistinct nucleoli
Tumor cells are larger and more uniform than surrounding lymphocytes and lack granules
Background of hemodilute marrow with scattered granulocytic precursors, neutrophils, erythroid precursors and a mitotic figure
Rosettes are not clearly identified in this field
3023.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hemodilute background with scattered maturing granulocytic and erythroid precursors. Several cohesive clusters of small-to-medium round cells with scant cytoplasm, high N:C ratios, finely granular chromatin and focal nuclear molding are present, clearly distinct from the dispersed hematopoietic cells. Well-formed Flexner-Wintersteiner or Homer Wright rosettes are not evident in this field. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by a metastatic small round blue cell tumor, in keeping with retinoblastoma in the appropriate clinical context; immunohistochemistry on a clot/biopsy (e.g. synaptophysin, CRX) is recommended.

ddx.vs: Neuroblastoma shows clusters with neuropil and Homer Wright rosettes in young children, with elevated urine catecholamines and PHOX2B positivity.
Leukemic blasts are dispersed and non-cohesive without molding and are CD45/TdT-positive.
Ewing sarcoma is CD99/NKX2.2-positive with EWSR1 rearrangement, and rhabdomyosarcoma expresses desmin/myogenin.
Hematogones are dispersed, homogeneous small cells with scant cytoplasm that do not form cohesive molded clusters and show a maturing B-cell phenotype.

2127.recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結免疫組化中，棕色陽性細胞密集分布於濾泡間與副皮質區，而多個淡藍色圓形濾泡區幾乎不著色，顯示擴張的 T 細胞區；抗體名稱未在圖中標示，須對照 ALPS 典型的雙陰性 T 細胞（CD3+ CD4- CD8-）判讀。
features: Low-power lymph node immunostain with numerous brown-positive small cells
Positive cells concentrated in expanded interfollicular/paracortical zones, focally forming dense aggregates
Multiple round pale follicle-shaped areas largely negative
Positive cells appear small and individually dispersed without sheets of large cells
Specific antibody not indicated in the image, limiting interpretation
2127.describe_en: Low-power immunohistochemical stain of a lymph node (antibody not specified in the image) shows numerous positive small cells concentrated in expanded interfollicular and paracortical regions, with focal dense aggregates, while multiple round follicle-like areas are largely negative. The distribution indicates an expanded T-zone or interfollicular population rather than follicular involvement. In autoimmune lymphoproliferative syndrome, paracortical T cells are increased and a large fraction are CD4- CD8- double-negative T cells; interpretation requires the corresponding CD3, CD4 and CD8 stains and flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Paracortical T cells are predominantly CD4+ or CD8+, without an expanded CD3+ CD4- CD8- population.
PTCL shows atypical T cells with aberrant antigen loss and clonal TCR rearrangement, whereas ALPS T cells are polyclonal.
Neoplastic follicles are CD10/BCL2 positive B-cell nodules, unlike the negative follicles and interfollicular staining pattern here.

1359.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中有數顆小型成熟淋巴球，核染色質緻密、胞質極少，並有多個被推破、呈扁平淡紫色不規則形的「塗抹細胞」（smudge cells，箭頭），此組合是 CLL 的典型血片表現；此視野血小板稀少。
features: Several small mature lymphocytes with round nuclei, dense clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm
Multiple smudge (basket) cells: flattened, disrupted lilac nuclear material with frayed, irregular borders (arrows)
Very few platelets in the field
Red cells largely normocytic and normochromic without significant poikilocytosis
No prolymphocytes or blasts evident in this field
1359.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an increase in small, mature-appearing lymphocytes with dense clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm, accompanied by numerous smudge cells representing fragile lymphocytes disrupted during smear preparation. Platelets appear decreased in this field, and red cells are unremarkable. No prolymphocytes are seen here. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia; flow cytometry (CD5+, CD23+, dim CD20 and surface Ig) is required for confirmation, and thrombocytopenia should be evaluated for immune destruction versus marrow infiltration.

ddx.vs: Cells often show irregular or cleaved nuclei and smudge cells are fewer; cyclin D1-positive and CD23-negative.
Lymphocytes are polyclonal and often more pleomorphic, and numerous smudge cells are uncommon.
Platelet clumps appear as granular aggregates of discrete platelets rather than homogeneous disrupted nuclear chromatin.
Lymphocytes have polar villous cytoplasmic projections and are usually CD5-negative.

2255.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大量含粗大橘紅色顆粒的細胞，包括核呈圓形或凹陷的嗜伊紅性骨髓細胞、後骨髓細胞與成熟雙葉嗜伊紅球，部分前驅細胞顆粒偏暗紫，顯示嗜伊紅球系各階段增生。
features: Numerous eosinophil lineage cells dominating the field
Eosinophilic myelocytes/metamyelocytes with round, indented or bilobed nuclei and cytoplasm packed with coarse orange-red granules
Occasional precursors with darker purplish immature granules
Scattered larger immature cells with open chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm (promyelocytes/myelocytes)
Small lymphocytes, erythroid precursors and a segmented neutrophil in the background
2255.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows marked eosinophilic hyperplasia with abundant eosinophilic myelocytes, metamyelocytes and mature forms containing coarse orange-red granules; a subset of precursors has darker, immature-appearing granules. Scattered immature granulocytic cells, lymphocytes and erythroid precursors are present, without an obvious excess of blasts in this field. Findings are consistent with bone marrow eosinophilia; correlation with peripheral eosinophil count, clinical history and cytogenetic/molecular testing for eosinophilia-associated rearrangements is recommended.

ddx.vs: Morphologically similar maturing eosinophils; excluded by clinical history and lack of clonal markers.
Requires clonal cytogenetic/molecular abnormality or increased blasts, often with dysplastic eosinophils.
Shows spindle-shaped CD25-positive mast cell aggregates on biopsy and KIT D816V mutation.
Abnormal eosinophils contain large purple-violet granules with increased myelomonocytic blasts.

1935.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中顆粒球系可見巨大後骨髓細胞與巨大帶狀核，紅系前驅細胞核大、染色質細緻篩網狀、核質發育不同步，右下角還有一顆有絲分裂中的細胞，整體細胞增生旺盛，符合巨母細胞性造血。
features: Giant metamyelocytes and giant bands with large, loosely folded horseshoe-shaped nuclei and granular cytoplasm
Megaloblastic erythroid precursors with large round nuclei and finely stippled open chromatin relative to polychromatic cytoplasm
Mitotic figure at lower right indicating active proliferation
Neutrophils with increased or abnormal nuclear lobation
Cellular aspirate particle with abundant precursors of all maturation stages
1935.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular particle with megaloblastic changes in both erythroid and granulocytic lineages. Erythroid precursors have large nuclei with finely stippled, open chromatin that lags behind cytoplasmic hemoglobinization, and granulocytic precursors include giant metamyelocytes and giant band forms. A mitotic figure is present, and blasts are not increased in this field. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic anemia.

ddx.vs: MDS shows megaloblastoid changes together with hypogranular or pseudo-Pelger neutrophils and dysplastic megakaryocytes, with normal B12/folate and possible clonal cytogenetics.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with erythroid predominance
ddx.vs: AML shows increased myeloblasts or sheets of immature erythroid cells, whereas here maturation is complete and blasts are not increased.
CDA shows binucleate or multinucleate erythroblasts and internuclear bridging with normal granulocytes, rather than giant metamyelocytes.

2383.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抽吸抹片中，在分散的造血細胞之間出現一團緻密、互相黏著、深紫色的細胞聚團，與周圍單個分布的骨髓細胞明顯不同，這種非造血性黏著細胞團提示轉移性腫瘤（神經母細胞瘤）。
features: Single dense, cohesive three-dimensional cluster of darkly staining cells in the center
Clustered cells appear small to intermediate with high N:C ratio and nuclear crowding
Background of dispersed, heterogeneous hematopoietic cells including maturing granulocytes
Detailed nuclear morphology cannot be resolved at this magnification
2383.describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular specimen with dispersed, heterogeneous maturing hematopoietic cells. Centrally, there is a tight, cohesive three-dimensional cluster of small to intermediate-sized cells with high N:C ratios and nuclear crowding, distinct from the surrounding dispersed marrow cells. Nuclear detail and the presence of neuropil or rosettes cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are suggestive of a metastatic tumor cluster, consistent with metastatic neuroblastoma in the appropriate clinical context.

ddx.vs: A particle contains mixed hematopoietic cells and fat, and a megakaryocyte is a single large cell, whereas this cluster is a monotonous cohesive aggregate.
Osteoblasts form loose groups of larger cells with eccentric nuclei, abundant basophilic cytoplasm and a paranuclear hof.

ddx.dx: Other metastatic small round cell tumors
ddx.vs: Ewing sarcoma, rhabdomyosarcoma and small cell carcinoma form similar clusters and require immunophenotyping to separate.

2831.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有大型、非造血細胞：細胞質灰藍且細胞質與核上都有多個清楚圓形空泡，其中一顆為雙核、染色質細顆粒狀，與周圍小淋巴球差異明顯，符合轉移性橫紋肌肉瘤。
features: Large atypical cells, one binucleate, much larger than adjacent lymphocytes
Round nuclei with finely granular chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Pale gray-blue cytoplasm with numerous small, sharply punched-out vacuoles, some overlying the nucleus
Background of small lymphoid cells and crenated red cells with drying artifact
No cytoplasmic granules seen in the tumor cells
2831.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows scattered large atypical cells that are distinctly larger than the surrounding lymphoid cells. One cell is binucleate; the nuclei are round with finely granular chromatin, and the gray-blue cytoplasm contains multiple small, sharply defined vacuoles that also overlie the nuclei. The background shows small lymphocytes and red cells with drying artifact. These cells are not of hematopoietic appearance and are suggestive of metastatic small round cell tumor; in the appropriate clinical setting, findings are consistent with rhabdomyosarcoma, to be confirmed by desmin/myogenin immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: Burkitt cells are uniform with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and lipid vacuoles, but they are not binucleate, are dispersed rather than clustered, and are CD20+/CD10+ rather than desmin/myogenin positive.
Neuroblastoma forms rosettes with a fibrillary neuropil background and lacks prominent cytoplasmic vacuoles; urine catecholamines and PHOX2B support it.
Ewing cells have scant cytoplasm with glycogen vacuoles and are CD99/NKX2-2 positive with EWSR1 rearrangement; morphology alone may not separate them.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with vacuolated blasts
ddx.vs: AML blasts are MPO or CD34/CD117 positive and dispersed, not large binucleate tumor cells that are desmin/myogenin positive.

1231.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中散在明顯大於周圍造血細胞的大型腫瘤細胞，核呈腎形或馬蹄形、有雙核細胞，細胞質豐富偏嗜鹼性並有多個空泡，符合 ALCL 的 hallmark cells 樣態。
features: Scattered very large neoplastic cells, several times the size of adjacent erythroid and myeloid precursors
Kidney-shaped, horseshoe-like and bilobed/binucleate nuclei
Coarsely stippled chromatin with visible nucleoli
Abundant grey-blue cytoplasm with prominent clear cytoplasmic vacuoles
Background of residual hematopoietic cells and red cells
1231.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows scattered, markedly enlarged atypical cells among residual hematopoietic elements. The large cells have abundant grey-blue, vacuolated cytoplasm and pleomorphic kidney-shaped, horseshoe-shaped or bilobed nuclei with coarse chromatin and nucleoli; one cell is binucleate. These cells resemble the hallmark cells of anaplastic large cell lymphoma. Confirmation requires CD30 (strong, uniform) and ALK immunostaining or flow cytometry. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by anaplastic large cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters and are keratin-positive, whereas ALCL cells are discohesive and CD30-positive with T-cell/cytotoxic markers.
Reed-Sternberg cells have huge eosinophilic inclusion-like nucleoli and are CD15+/PAX5 weak, while ALCL shows horseshoe nuclei, vacuolated cytoplasm and ALK or cytotoxic marker expression.
Monoblasts have fine chromatin, folded nuclei and fine granules with nonspecific esterase positivity, whereas ALCL cells are more pleomorphic, CD30+ and MPO/NSE negative.
Megakaryocytes have granular pink cytoplasm and multilobated nuclei without clear vacuoles and express CD61, unlike these vacuolated CD30+ cells.

1295.recognize_zh: 低細胞量的腦脊髓液細胞離心抹片中，可見少數圓形細胞具偏心核、塊狀染色質與較豐富的灰藍細胞質，形態像漿細胞，配合骨髓瘤病史提示中樞神經侵犯；但倍率低，細節有限。
features: Paucicellular cytocentrifuge preparation with scattered red cells
Occasional medium-sized round cells with eccentric nuclei, coarse clock-face-like chromatin and moderate gray-blue cytoplasm, suggestive of plasma cells
Few small cells with dense nuclei and scant cytoplasm (lymphocytes)
Several degenerated/smudged cells with frayed cytoplasm
Low magnification limits assessment of perinuclear hof, nucleoli and cytoplasmic detail
1295.describe_en: Cerebrospinal fluid cytospin is paucicellular and contains scattered red cells, a few small lymphocytes, degenerated cells, and occasional medium-sized round cells with eccentric nuclei, coarse chromatin and moderate gray-blue cytoplasm resembling plasma cells. Given the low magnification, perinuclear hofs and nucleoli cannot be reliably assessed, and immunophenotypic confirmation (e.g., flow cytometry for CD138/CD38 with light chain restriction) is recommended. In a patient with plasma cell myeloma, the presence of plasma cells in CSF is suggestive of CNS involvement by myeloma.

ddx.dx: Reactive plasma cells in CSF (infection, demyelinating disease)
ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are polytypic and accompanied by a mixed lymphocytic pleocytosis, whereas myeloma cells show light chain restriction.
Monocytes have folded or kidney-shaped nuclei with fine chromatin and vacuolated gray cytoplasm without an eccentric clock-face nucleus.
Lymphoma cells are usually larger with irregular nuclei and express B-cell markers (CD20, PAX5) rather than a pure CD138+ plasma cell phenotype.

1103.recognize_zh: 周邊血中兩顆淋巴球：左邊小而緻密，右邊稍大、核輪廓略不規則且胞質少；在此倍率下看不清典型腦回狀核，只能提示 Sézary 細胞，需高倍或流式細胞儀確認。
features: Two lymphoid cells: one small with dense chromatin, one slightly larger with mildly irregular nucleus
High N:C ratio with scant pale-blue agranular cytoplasm
Nuclear grooves/cerebriform folds not clearly resolved at this magnification
Normal segmented neutrophil for size comparison
Red cells with prominent central pallor; platelets present
1103.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two lymphoid cells, one small with dense chromatin and one slightly larger with a mildly irregular nuclear outline and scant agranular cytoplasm, adjacent to a normal segmented neutrophil. The characteristic cerebriform nuclear folding is not clearly resolved at this magnification. Red cells show prominent central pallor. The lymphoid cells are compatible with, but not diagnostic of, Sézary cells; flow cytometry for CD4+ T cells with loss of CD7 and/or CD26 is required.

ddx.vs: Normal lymphocytes have smooth round nuclear contours and are not phenotypically aberrant by flow cytometry.
CLL cells have coarse clumped chromatin, frequent smudge cells and a CD5+/CD23+ B-cell phenotype.
T-PLL cells have more basophilic cytoplasm with blebs and visible nucleoli, and show TCL1 rearrangement.

4239.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血抹片中可見數顆雙葉核、細胞質含粗大顆粒的嗜酸性球，數量相對中性球偏多，另有一顆小淋巴球；紅血球大小不一並有橢圓形紅血球，整體提示嗜酸性球增多。
features: Several eosinophils with bilobed nuclei and cytoplasm filled with coarse granules
Eosinophils appear proportionally increased relative to neutrophils in this field
Occasional segmented neutrophil and a small lymphocyte
Red cells with anisopoikilocytosis including ovalocytes
Platelets present but low magnification limits granule and cytologic detail
4239.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low-medium power shows several eosinophils with bilobed nuclei and coarse cytoplasmic granules, together with occasional neutrophils and a small lymphocyte. Red cells show anisopoikilocytosis with ovalocytes. Detailed assessment of granulation and dysplasia is limited at this magnification. Findings are consistent with eosinophilia; an absolute eosinophil count and clinical correlation are needed to determine its cause.

ddx.vs: Neutrophils have three to five nuclear lobes and fine granules rather than bilobed nuclei with coarse uniform granules.
CEL requires clonality or increased blasts, and may show dysplastic eosinophils; morphology of mature eosinophils alone cannot separate it from reactive eosinophilia.

1039.recognize_zh: 高倍周邊血抹片中，一顆分葉核中性球下方有一大團聚集的血小板（platelet clump），而紅血球間幾乎沒有單獨散在的血小板，這種聚集會讓儀器低估血小板數，是假性血小板低下的直接證據。
features: Large aggregate of platelets with granular purple centers below the neutrophil
Individual platelets within the clump are normal in size
Segmented neutrophil with multiple nuclear lobes and fine cytoplasmic granules
Very few single free platelets among the red cells
Red cells with rouleaux-like stacking in thicker areas of the smear
1039.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows a large aggregate of normal-sized platelets adjacent to a segmented neutrophil, with very few free single platelets in the field. Red cells are normochromic and stacked in thicker areas of the smear. Findings demonstrate in vitro platelet clumping and are consistent with pseudothrombocytopenia, most often EDTA-dependent; the platelet count should be verified on a citrated sample or by smear estimate.

ddx.vs: ITP shows genuinely reduced platelets, often large, without aggregates on the smear.
Satellitism is platelet rosetting around the neutrophil membrane rather than a free-lying aggregate.
A giant platelet is a single cell with uniform granular cytoplasm, while a clump shows multiple discrete platelets with separate outlines.

4111.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片中成片的中型小圓藍細胞，核圓、染色質細顆粒狀、細胞質稀少，排列成群並埋在淡粉紅色纖維狀基質（neuropil）中，與周圍的造血細胞明顯不同，提示轉移性神經母細胞瘤。
features: Clusters and sheets of small to medium round blue cells, larger than mature lymphocytes
Round to oval nuclei with finely granular, salt-and-pepper chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
Scant, ill-defined cytoplasm with nuclear crowding
Pale pink fibrillary background matrix (neuropil-like) between tumor cells
Residual normal hematopoietic cells and red cells at the periphery
4111.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows large cohesive aggregates of small to medium-sized round cells with round nuclei, finely granular chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant cytoplasm, set within a pale pink fibrillary matrix. These cells are distinct from the scattered residual hematopoietic elements. Findings are suggestive of metastatic small round blue cell tumor, consistent with neuroblastoma in the appropriate clinical setting; confirmation with biopsy immunohistochemistry (PHOX2B, synaptophysin) and urine catecholamines is recommended.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts are discohesive single cells without fibrillary matrix and express TdT/CD34 rather than neuroendocrine markers.
Ewing cells often have vacuolated PAS-positive cytoplasm, lack neuropil and are CD99/NKX2.2 positive with EWSR1 rearrangement.
Rhabdomyosarcoma cells may be multinucleated or vacuolated and express desmin/myogenin rather than PHOX2B.

4175.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央一顆漿細胞核偏位、染色質粗塊，胞質豐富且帶淡紫紅色調而非一般的深藍色，這種胞質富含免疫球蛋白的樣子就是火焰細胞（flame cell），常與 IgA 骨髓瘤相關。
features: Plasma cell with eccentric round nucleus and clumped chromatin
Abundant cytoplasm with a pinkish-lilac (reddish-purple) hue instead of deep blue
Smooth cytoplasmic borders without granules
Adjacent large cell with round nucleus and fine chromatin
Background myelocytes, band neutrophils, erythroid precursors and small lymphocytes
4175.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows mixed hematopoietic elements including granulocytic precursors, band neutrophils and erythroid precursors. A plasma cell in the center displays an eccentric nucleus with clumped chromatin and abundant cytoplasm with a reddish-purple (flame-like) tint, representing a 'flame cell'. The fuchsia coloration is relatively subtle in this preparation. Flame cells reflect immunoglobulin-rich cytoplasm and are most often associated with IgA plasma cell myeloma, though they are not specific and can occur in reactive plasmacytosis.

ddx.vs: Mott cells contain multiple discrete round pale Russell bodies (grape-like) rather than diffusely pink cytoplasm.
Granulocytic precursors show azurophilic or specific granules and a paler perinuclear Golgi area without the plasma cell's clumped clock-face chromatin.
Reactive plasma cells usually have deep blue cytoplasm with a hof and are polytypic on kappa/lambda studies.
Thesaurocytes are enlarged plasma cells with abundant pale-to-pink cytoplasm distending the cell; the distinction from flame cells is descriptive rather than diagnostic.

3983.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片幾乎全被大小不一的母細胞取代，核質比高、染色質細緻、核形不規則或有凹陷，細胞質少且淡藍無顆粒，部分呈拖尾的手鏡狀（hand-mirror）；單一形態母細胞成片且無顆粒，符合急性淋巴母細胞白血病復發。
features: Marrow replaced by a monotonous population of blasts with only rare residual normal cells
Variable blast size (small to large) with high N:C ratio
Round to irregular, indented or cleaved nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin; occasional small nucleoli
Scant pale to moderately basophilic agranular cytoplasm, some with hand-mirror tails and small vacuoles
Smudged cells and platelet clumps in background; no Auer rods
3983.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is diffusely replaced by blasts that vary from small to large, with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round to irregular or indented nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and occasional small nucleoli. The cytoplasm is scant, agranular and pale blue, with some cells showing hand-mirror projections; Auer rods are not seen. Normal hematopoietic elements are markedly reduced. In a child with previously treated precursor B-ALL, findings are consistent with relapsed acute lymphoblastic leukemia, to be confirmed by flow cytometry and cytogenetic/molecular studies.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts often show fine azurophilic granules or Auer rods and are MPO positive, whereas lymphoblasts are agranular and MPO negative.
Hematogones have more condensed homogeneous chromatin, rarely efface the marrow, and show normal maturation without aberrant antigens on flow cytometry.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent lipid vacuoles and a mature B-cell (surface immunoglobulin-positive, TdT-negative) phenotype.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor (neuroblastoma, rhabdomyosarcoma)
ddx.vs: Small round cell tumors form cohesive clusters or rosettes and are CD45 negative, unlike discohesive lymphoblasts.

4047.recognize_zh: 周邊血中一顆比紅血球大約兩倍的淋巴球，核略呈腎形、染色質成塊，細胞質豐富淡藍且散布細小紅紫色嗜天青顆粒（azurophilic granule）；豐富細胞質內的嗜天青顆粒就是大顆粒淋巴球（large granular lymphocyte, LGL）的辨識重點。
features: Medium to large lymphocyte about twice the diameter of a red cell
Moderate to abundant pale blue cytoplasm with low N:C ratio
Fine to coarse azurophilic granules scattered in the cytoplasm
Round to slightly indented nucleus with condensed, clumped chromatin; no nucleoli
Background red cells normochromic and normocytic; small platelet clump nearby
4047.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large granular lymphocyte with an indented nucleus, condensed chromatin and abundant pale blue cytoplasm containing scattered azurophilic granules. Red cells are normocytic and normochromic, and platelets are present. A single cell does not establish a diagnosis; a persistent absolute large granular lymphocyte count above 2 x 10^9/L with clonality demonstrated by flow cytometry (CD3+, CD8+, CD57+) and TRG/TRB rearrangement or STAT3 mutation is required for T-cell large granular lymphocytic leukemia.

ddx.dx: Reactive large granular lymphocytosis (viral infection, post-transplant, splenectomy)
ddx.vs: Reactive LGLs are morphologically identical and polyclonal, and the increase is transient.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells
ddx.vs: NK-cell LGLs look the same but are surface CD3-negative, CD56-positive with no TCR rearrangement.
Aggressive NK-cell leukemia shows larger atypical cells with irregular nuclei, visible nucleoli and more basophilic cytoplasm, often EBV positive.
Hairy cells have circumferential hair-like cytoplasmic projections and oval or bean-shaped nuclei with spongy chromatin but lack azurophilic granules.

3919.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一顆巨噬細胞的細胞質內含有多顆被吞噬的紅血球與小而深染的核碎片，細胞邊緣還附著數顆小型有核細胞，是典型的吞紅血球現象（erythrophagocytosis）。
features: Large macrophage with abundant pale blue-grey cytoplasm
Multiple ingested intact red cells within cytoplasmic vacuoles
Small dense pyknotic nuclear fragments within the cytoplasm
Small round dark nucleated cells adherent to or engulfed at the cell margin
Macrophage nucleus with open chromatin
Adjacent granulated myeloid precursors in the background
3919.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a macrophage containing several intact phagocytosed red blood cells within cytoplasmic vacuoles, along with small pyknotic nuclear fragments, and with small nucleated cells adherent to its surface. The surrounding marrow shows granulated myeloid precursors. Findings demonstrate erythrophagocytosis (hemophagocytosis); this is a nonspecific finding and must be interpreted with clinical and laboratory criteria for hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis.

ddx.vs: Storage histiocytes contain lipid or ceroid material rather than recognizable engulfed red cells and nucleated cells.
Tingible body macrophages contain apoptotic nuclear debris only, without ingested intact erythrocytes.
In erythroblastic islands, erythroid precursors surround a central macrophage without being engulfed, and intracytoplasmic red cells are absent.
Overlapping red cells lie on top of the cytoplasm without vacuolar halos, whereas true phagocytosed cells sit within distinct vacuoles.

3855.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一群大型異常淋巴細胞聚集：核大、染色質細緻，細胞質嗜鹼性並有空泡與胞質泡突，體積遠大於右下角的小型深染細胞，符合血管內大型 B 細胞淋巴瘤細胞。
features: Cluster of large atypical lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei much larger than red cells
Finely granular chromatin with occasional small nucleoli
Moderate basophilic cytoplasm with fine vacuoles and cytoplasmic blebs/budding
Some cells with peripheral deeply basophilic cytoplasmic rim
Group of small, dark, round cells (likely erythroid precursors/lymphocytes) at lower right for size comparison
3855.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of large atypical lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei, finely granular chromatin, and moderate amounts of basophilic, finely vacuolated cytoplasm with blebs. These cells dwarf the adjacent small, dark erythroid precursors and lymphocytes. Findings are consistent with involvement by large B-cell lymphoma, compatible with intravascular large B-cell lymphoma in the clinical context; immunophenotyping and biopsy demonstration of intrasinusoidal growth are recommended.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells form tightly cohesive clusters with molding and are keratin positive and CD45 negative, whereas lymphoma clusters here are loose aggregates.
Blasts are usually smaller with a higher N:C ratio and are CD34/TdT or MPO positive rather than mature B-cell marker positive.
Plasmablasts show eccentric nuclei with a perinuclear hof and are CD138/MUM1 positive and CD20 negative.
Histiocytes have abundant pale cytoplasm with engulfed cells and low N:C ratio, unlike these deeply basophilic lymphoid cells.

3663.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中的分葉核嗜中性球，細胞質內布滿粗大深紫色的毒性顆粒（toxic granulation），右上方還有一小片淡藍色的 Döhle body，符合 G-CSF 刺激後的變化。
features: Segmented neutrophil with three to four lobes and clumped chromatin
Prominent coarse dark purple (toxic) granules throughout the cytoplasm
Small pale blue cytoplasmic patch near the periphery consistent with a Döhle body
Surrounding red cells are normocytic and normochromic with central pallor
No cytoplasmic vacuoles or organisms identified in this cell
