3663.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mature segmented neutrophil with coarse, dark purple cytoplasmic granulation throughout the cytoplasm and a small peripheral pale blue inclusion consistent with a Döhle body. The nucleus shows normal segmentation and chromatin condensation. Background red cells are unremarkable. In the setting of growth factor therapy, these findings are consistent with G-CSF effect; the same toxic changes are also seen in infection and inflammation.

ddx.vs: Morphologically identical toxic granulation and Döhle bodies, so the distinction rests on history of G-CSF administration versus clinical evidence of infection.
Shows large dark azurophilic granules in all leukocytes including lymphocytes and monocytes, persistent in health and not accompanied by Döhle bodies.
Has larger, more sharply defined spindle-shaped blue inclusions with giant platelets and thrombocytopenia, without toxic granulation.

3535.recognize_zh: 整片骨髓被單一形態的中型芽細胞取代，核質比極高、核形不規則或有摺痕、染色質細緻，偶見少量成熟小淋巴球，符合前驅 T 淋巴芽細胞白血病；確診需流式細胞儀（cytoplasmic CD3）。
features: Sheets of medium-sized blasts with very high N:C ratio and scant basophilic cytoplasm
Nuclei round to irregular, some with convolutions or indentations
Finely dispersed to slightly condensed chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
Absence of cytoplasmic granules or Auer rods
Scattered small mature lymphocytes and rare residual myeloid elements; many smudged cells
3535.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hypercellular and largely replaced by a monotonous population of medium-sized blasts. The blasts have scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm, round to irregular and occasionally convoluted nuclei, fine chromatin, and inconspicuous nucleoli. No Auer rods are seen, and normal hematopoietic elements are markedly reduced. Findings are consistent with lymphoblastic leukemia; lineage assignment as precursor T-lymphoblastic leukemia requires flow cytometry (cytoplasmic CD3, TdT).

ddx.vs: B-ALL blasts are morphologically indistinguishable and require flow cytometry showing CD19, CD79a, and CD22 rather than cytoplasmic CD3.
Minimally differentiated AML blasts also lack granules and need MPO/flow cytometry (CD13, CD33, CD117) to separate.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent lipid vacuoles and are TdT-negative mature B cells.

3471.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中出現一團彼此黏附、邊界不清的大型細胞群（cohesive cluster），核大、核質比高、核互相重疊，與周圍分散的造血細胞明顯不同，提示轉移性癌細胞；HER2 狀態無法從此染色判斷。
features: Large cohesive, three-dimensional cluster of non-hematopoietic cells with indistinct cell borders (syncytial appearance)
Large oval nuclei with high N:C ratio, nuclear overlapping and molding
Coarse to vesicular chromatin; some nuclei with visible nucleoli
Pale blue, finely vacuolated shared cytoplasm
Cluster size and cohesion distinctly different from surrounding dispersed marrow cells and red cells
3471.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large, cohesive cluster of foreign cells set against a blood-rich background. The cells are large, with oval overlapping nuclei, high N:C ratios, variably prominent nucleoli and pale blue, vacuolated cytoplasm with indistinct cell borders. The clustering and molding are not features of hematopoietic cells. Findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma involving the marrow; in this clinical context metastatic breast carcinoma is favored, but HER2 status requires immunohistochemistry on the biopsy or clot section.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes are individually large with lobulated single nuclei and granular pink cytoplasm, not tightly molded clusters of separate overlapping oval nuclei.
Osteoblasts form loose groups of plasmacytoid cells with eccentric nuclei and a pale perinuclear hof away from the nucleus, rather than syncytial clusters with high N:C ratio.
Hematopoietic tumor cells dissociate and lack true cohesion and nuclear molding; immunostaining for cytokeratin versus CD45 resolves difficult cases.

3215.recognize_zh: 箭頭指向中性球核葉旁以細柄相連的一顆小而緻密的圓形染色質突起（drumstick），即 Barr body；此中性球約有五葉，紅血球背景呈乾燥假影。
features: Segmented neutrophil with about five nuclear lobes
Small, round, dense chromatin drumstick attached to a lobe by a short thin stalk (arrow)
Finely granular pale-pink cytoplasm
Red cells with variable central pallor and drying/refractile artifact; occasional crenated cells
Scattered platelets in background
3215.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil with approximately five nuclear lobes and a small, round, dense chromatin appendage attached to one lobe by a thin stalk, consistent with a drumstick. Red cells show drying artifact with irregular central pallor, and platelets are present. A single five-lobed neutrophil is not sufficient to define hypersegmentation. Findings represent a Barr body (inactive X chromosome) in a neutrophil, a normal finding in females.

ddx.vs: Hypersegmentation requires at least 6 lobes in one cell or more than 5% five-lobed neutrophils and is not defined by a small round appendage.
Nodules lack the thin filament and discrete round head that define a drumstick.
Döhle bodies are pale-blue cytoplasmic patches at the cell periphery, not dense chromatin connected to the nucleus.

3151.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中可見多個一端拉長成尾巴的淚滴狀紅血球（dacrocyte），並有紅血球大小不一，這是原發性骨髓纖維化（agnogenic myeloid metaplasia）的典型周邊血表現。
features: Several teardrop-shaped red cells (dacrocytes) with single tapered tails
Mild anisocytosis with occasional ovalocytes
Rare red cell with a small basophilic inclusion
Scattered small platelets
No nucleated cells in this field; red cell overlap in thicker areas
3151.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows anisopoikilocytosis with several teardrop cells (dacrocytes) bearing single tapered tails and occasional ovalocytes. A rare red cell contains a small basophilic inclusion, and small platelets are scattered. No nucleated red cells or immature granulocytes are present in this field. Findings are consistent with teardrop poikilocytosis as seen in primary myelofibrosis; evaluation of the leukoerythroblastic picture, JAK2/CALR/MPL mutation status and bone marrow biopsy with reticulin stain is recommended.

ddx.dx: Myelophthisis (metastatic tumor or granulomatous marrow infiltration)
ddx.vs: Myelophthisic anemia produces identical teardrop cells and a leukoerythroblastic smear, so separation requires marrow biopsy showing infiltrating tumor or granulomas rather than MPN fibrosis.
Thalassemia may show teardrop cells but is accompanied by marked microcytosis, target cells and basophilic stippling.
Artifactual teardrops have tails pointing in the same direction in one area of the smear, whereas true dacrocytes have randomly oriented tails.

2959.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片免疫染色（抗原未標示）顯示細胞密度高，骨小樑間有大量棕色陽性細胞散布，與藍色陰性細胞交錯；需知道所用抗體才能判讀骨髓系成熟程度。
features: Hypercellular marrow with few fat spaces between trabeculae
Numerous brown-positive cells distributed diffusely in an interstitial pattern
Positive cells intermixed with hematoxylin-counterstained negative cells
No discrete clusters or sheets of positive cells
Specific antigen not indicated in the image
2959.describe_en: Low-power immunohistochemical stain of a bone marrow core biopsy (antigen not specified) shows a hypercellular marrow in which numerous brown-positive cells are dispersed diffusely in an interstitial pattern among hematoxylin-counterstained negative cells. No sheets or aggregates of positive cells are seen. Interpretation depends on the antibody used; in severe congenital neutropenia, myeloid markers such as MPO typically highlight preserved early granulocytic precursors with a paucity of mature neutrophils.

ddx.vs: Reactive marrow shows full granulocytic maturation to segmented neutrophils on H&E and aspirate, unlike maturation arrest.
AML shows sheets of CD34-positive blasts rather than a dispersed mixed population.
MDS shows multilineage dysplasia and clonal cytogenetic abnormalities.

2895.recognize_zh: 中倍 LAP 染色：5 顆中性球核被染成紅色，細胞質內有數量不等的藍色顆粒，可看出強度的差別，是練習 LAP 評分（0–4 分）的視野。
features: Five segmented neutrophils with red-counterstained lobulated nuclei
Blue granular cytoplasmic LAP reaction product of variable density between cells
Unstained tan red cells in background; no nuclear obscuring by reaction product
2895.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear stained for leukocyte alkaline phosphatase at intermediate magnification shows five neutrophils with red-counterstained nuclei. Each contains blue granular reaction product in the cytoplasm, with intensity varying from sparse to moderate between cells, without complete obscuring of the nucleus. These cells would be graded individually (approximately 1+ to 3+) as part of a 100-neutrophil LAP score.

ddx.vs: A score-0 cell shows no blue granules at all, only the red nucleus and pale cytoplasm.
A 4+ cell has confluent dark blue precipitate filling the cytoplasm and obscuring the nucleus.

2703.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中多顆細胞的細胞質塞滿粗大顆粒，部分為橘紅色、部分帶深紫藍色（未成熟嗜酸性顆粒），核為圓形或腎形，屬嗜酸性骨髓球與後骨髓球；嗜酸系明顯增加是線索，但特發性嗜酸性球增多症需排除其他原因才能診斷。
features: Increased eosinophil precursors (eosinophilic myelocytes and metamyelocytes) with round-to-indented nuclei
Cytoplasm packed with coarse granules, a mixture of orange-pink mature and purple-blue immature (pro-eosinophilic) granules
Earlier granulocytic precursor with blue cytoplasm and fine granules
No clearly increased blasts in this field
Scattered orthochromatic normoblast and red cells in background
2703.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of granulocytic cells dominated by eosinophil lineage precursors, including eosinophilic myelocytes and metamyelocytes with coarse cytoplasmic granules, some of which retain purple-blue immature staining. An earlier granulocytic precursor and an orthochromatic normoblast are also present. Blasts are not increased in this field and the eosinophil granules appear uniform without large abnormal basophilic granules. Findings show marked eosinophilic hyperplasia, compatible with idiopathic hypereosinophilic syndrome only after exclusion of reactive causes, PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1/JAK2/FLT3 rearrangements, clonal cytogenetic abnormalities, and systemic mastocytosis.

ddx.dx: Myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and PDGFRA rearrangement (FIP1L1::PDGFRA)
ddx.vs: Morphology is similar; diagnosis requires FISH or RT-PCR for the CHIC2 deletion/FIP1L1::PDGFRA fusion, often with increased atypical mast cells and elevated tryptase.
CEL requires evidence of clonality or increased blasts (≥2% in blood or ≥5% in marrow) and abnormal eosinophil morphology, which are not demonstrated here.

ddx.dx: Reactive eosinophilia (parasites, drugs, allergy, T-cell lymphoma)
ddx.vs: Reactive eosinophilia cannot be separated on marrow morphology and is excluded clinically, serologically and by T-cell clonality studies.
Inv(16) shows increased blasts and abnormal eosinophils with large dark purple basophilic granules in a myelomonocytic background.

2447.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中兩個比紅血球大的原始淋巴球：核質比高、染色質細緻、胞質極少，上方細胞核有明顯缺刻（nuclear notch），下方細胞可見小核仁；需以流式細胞儀確認 T 細胞系（cCD3）。
features: Two medium-sized blasts, about 1.5–2 times the diameter of a red cell
High N:C ratio with scant pale blue cytoplasm
Upper cell with a nuclear notch/indentation and denser chromatin
Lower cell with finely dispersed chromatin and a faint nucleolus
No cytoplasmic granules or Auer rods; background normocytic red cells
2447.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two circulating blasts of medium size with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, scant agranular cytoplasm and finely dispersed chromatin; one has a nuclear indentation and the other a faint nucleolus. No granules or Auer rods are seen. The background red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with circulating lymphoblasts; lineage assignment as T-lymphoblastic leukemia requires flow cytometry (cytoplasmic CD3, CD7, TdT).

ddx.vs: B-lymphoblasts are morphologically indistinguishable and are separated by expression of CD19, CD79a and CD22 instead of cytoplasmic CD3.
Myeloblasts may lack granules but are MPO or CD13/CD33/CD117 positive rather than cCD3 positive.
Reactive lymphocytes have condensed chromatin and more abundant basophilic cytoplasm that hugs adjacent red cells.
Sézary cells have condensed, cerebriform chromatin and are TdT and CD34 negative.

2191.recognize_zh: 胃腺體上皮內有成群小至中型、核略不規則的中心細胞樣（centrocyte-like）淋巴球侵入，形成淋巴上皮病灶（lymphoepithelial lesion），固有層則被相似細胞密集浸潤，是胃 MALT 淋巴瘤的關鍵線索。
features: Dense lamina propria infiltrate of small-to-medium lymphoid cells
Centrocyte-like cells with slightly irregular nuclei and moderate pale cytoplasm
Aggregates of lymphoid cells infiltrating and distorting gastric gland epithelium (lymphoepithelial lesions)
Glandular epithelial cells show eosinophilic change and are separated by intraepithelial lymphocytes
Background of scattered plasma cells; no sheets of large cells
2191.describe_en: Sections of gastric mucosa show gastric glands surrounded by a dense lamina propria infiltrate of small-to-medium lymphoid cells with slightly irregular nuclei and moderate pale cytoplasm, resembling centrocyte-like or monocytoid B cells. Clusters of these cells invade and distort the glandular epithelium, forming lymphoepithelial lesions. No sheets of large transformed cells are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue (MALT lymphoma); immunohistochemistry (CD20+, CD5-, CD10-, cyclin D1-), H. pylori assessment and testing for t(11;18) are recommended.

ddx.dx: Helicobacter pylori chronic gastritis with lymphoid hyperplasia
ddx.vs: Reactive gastritis has reactive follicles and a mixed polytypic infiltrate without destructive lymphoepithelial lesions or dense monotonous CD20+ sheets.
Mantle cell lymphoma is composed of monotonous CD5+ cyclin D1+ cells and rarely forms prominent lymphoepithelial lesions.
DLBCL shows confluent sheets of large cells with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli rather than small centrocyte-like cells.
Signet ring carcinoma cells contain mucin vacuoles and are keratin positive, not CD20 positive.

1871.recognize_zh: 周邊血中可見多顆中大型異常細胞，細胞質強嗜鹼性（深藍紫色）且邊緣有細胞質泡狀突起（cytoplasmic blebs），顆粒稀少，核形不規則，形態近似微核巨核細胞或嗜鹼性胚細胞，符合高嗜鹼性變異型急性前骨髓細胞白血病。
features: Medium to large abnormal cells with high N:C ratio
Round to irregular nuclei with moderately fine chromatin
Intensely basophilic cytoplasm with sparse or absent granules
Cytoplasmic blebs/budding projections resembling micromegakaryocytes
Scattered small dark cells (lymphocytes or nucleated red cells) and platelets in background
1871.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous medium to large abnormal cells with round to irregular nuclei, a high N:C ratio and a narrow rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm that bears prominent blebs and budding projections. Cytoplasmic granules are sparse, and Auer rods are not evident in this field. The red cells are normochromic with mild anisopoikilocytosis. The morphology mimics megakaryoblasts or basophilic blasts; in the context of PML-RARA positivity, findings are consistent with the hyperbasophilic variant of acute promyelocytic leukemia, and strong MPO positivity supports it.

ddx.vs: Megakaryoblasts share basophilic blebbed cytoplasm but are MPO negative and CD41/CD61 positive, whereas hyperbasophilic APL is strongly MPO positive with PML-RARA.
Basophilic blasts contain coarse metachromatic granules and are MPO negative, CD123/CD203c positive and lack PML-RARA.
Microgranular APL has pale cytoplasm with dust-like granules and bilobed nuclei rather than deeply basophilic blebbed cytoplasm; both are confirmed by PML-RARA.

1679.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片以大型細胞為主，核圓或卵圓、部分有摺痕或凹陷，染色質細緻呈網狀、可見核仁，細胞質豐富呈灰藍色、邊緣有偽足狀突起，這是單核母細胞/前單核細胞的特徵，符合急性單核球性白血病。
features: Large blasts with moderate to abundant cytoplasm (lower N:C ratio than lymphoblasts)
Round to oval nuclei, some indented or folded (promonocyte-like)
Finely reticular, lacy chromatin with one or more nucleoli
Grey-blue cytoplasm with cytoplasmic blebs/pseudopod-like projections and occasional vacuoles
Granules sparse; no Auer rods identified
Few residual maturing cells in the background
1679.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is largely replaced by large blasts with abundant grey-blue cytoplasm, round to oval or indented nuclei, finely reticular chromatin and visible nucleoli. The cytoplasm shows irregular blebs and pseudopod-like projections with occasional vacuoles, and granules are sparse without Auer rods. Residual normal hematopoiesis is minimal. Findings are consistent with acute monoblastic/monocytic leukemia; confirmation by nonspecific esterase cytochemistry and flow cytometry (CD14, CD64, CD11b, CD4, lysozyme) is recommended, along with testing for KMT2A rearrangement.

ddx.vs: AMML contains at least 20% neutrophil-lineage cells and MPO-positive myeloblasts in addition to monocytic cells, whereas this field is dominated by monoblasts/promonocytes.
Often monocytic with cup-like nuclei; separated by NPM1 mutation testing and cytoplasmic NPM1 immunostaining rather than morphology alone.
BPDCN cells have agranular cytoplasm with small peripheral vacuoles and are CD4/CD56/CD123/TCF4-positive but NSE- and lysozyme-negative.

ddx.dx: Large cell lymphoma in leukemic phase
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm, coarser chromatin and B- or T-cell markers without monocytic esterase activity.

1615.recognize_zh: 免疫組織化學染色中，一個圓形區域（生發中心）幾乎不染，周圍一圈小淋巴球則呈棕色膜狀陽性，形成「中空甜甜圈」樣式，符合正常反應性濾泡中外套區陽性、生發中心陰性的抗原表現。
features: Round central zone of largely unstained cells (germinal center)
Surrounding cells with brown membranous/cytoplasmic staining forming a ring (mantle zone) and extending into interfollicular areas
Only rare positive cells within the negative central zone
Faint counterstain limiting cytologic detail
Specific antigen not identified in the image
1615.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain of lymphoid tissue at low-to-medium power shows a round, largely negative germinal center surrounded by positively stained small lymphocytes of the mantle and interfollicular zones, with only rare positive cells within the center. The antigen is not specified; this reciprocal pattern is typical of markers such as BCL2 or IgD in a normal reactive follicle. Findings are consistent with a normal secondary follicle with a negative germinal center.

ddx.vs: In FL, neoplastic follicle centers are BCL2 positive, whereas here the germinal center is negative with positivity confined to the surrounding cells.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma, mantle zone pattern
ddx.vs: MCL expands the mantle with cyclin D1/SOX11-positive cells, which cannot be distinguished from normal mantle cells on this stain without the specific antigen.

60303.recognize_zh: 紅血球大小一致，直徑與中央小淋巴球的核相當，有正常的中央淡染區，左上方另有一顆分節嗜中性球可作比較，是正常大小紅血球（normocytic RBCs）的參考圖。
features: Red cells uniform in size, approximately equal to the nucleus of the small lymphocyte
Normochromic with central pallor about one-third of the cell diameter
Minimal anisocytosis and poikilocytosis; some overlapping cells in a slightly thick area
Small lymphocyte in center and segmented neutrophil at upper left for size reference
No inclusions, fragments or nucleated red cells seen
60303.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows red cells that are uniform in size and shape, about the same diameter as the nucleus of a small lymphocyte, with normal central pallor. Some cells overlap because the field is slightly thick, but no significant anisopoikilocytosis, spherocytes, target cells or schistocytes are seen. A small lymphocyte and a segmented neutrophil are present. Findings are consistent with normocytic, normochromic red cells.

ddx.vs: Microcytes are clearly smaller than the small lymphocyte nucleus, usually with increased central pallor.
Macrocytes are clearly larger than the small lymphocyte nucleus and often oval.

60047.recognize_zh: 中央一顆嗜中性球的細胞核分成約 7–8 個分葉，遠超過正常的 3–4 葉（≥6 葉即明確過度分葉），細胞質仍有正常細小顆粒，這就是過度分葉嗜中性球（hypersegmented neutrophil）。
features: Single mature neutrophil, slightly larger than usual (macropolycyte-range size, roughly 1.5-2x RBC diameter)
Nucleus divided into approximately 7-8 discrete lobes connected by thin chromatin strands
Coarse, condensed chromatin in each lobe; no nucleoli
Pale pink-lilac cytoplasm with fine, evenly distributed neutrophilic granules; no toxic granulation or vacuoles
Background red cells are normochromic without obvious macro-ovalocytes in this limited field
60047.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear, high power, shows a mature neutrophil with marked nuclear hypersegmentation, with approximately seven to eight nuclear lobes. The cytoplasm contains fine neutrophilic granules without toxic changes, Döhle bodies, or vacuolization. The surrounding red cells in this small field are round and normochromic; macro-ovalocytes are not evident, and the red cell indices and a full smear review would be needed to assess for megaloblastic changes. Findings are consistent with a hypersegmented neutrophil, as seen in megaloblastic anemia (vitamin B12 or folate deficiency).

ddx.vs: A normal neutrophil has 3-4 lobes, whereas this cell has well over five (a single 6-lobed neutrophil or >5% with 5 lobes defines hypersegmentation).
Morphologically identical, but it is a benign familial finding with normal B12/folate levels and no macrocytosis or megaloblastic marrow.

ddx.dx: Drug-related or myelodysplastic hypersegmentation (e.g., hydroxyurea, methotrexate, MDS)
ddx.vs: Cannot be separated on one cell; clinical drug history, B12/folate levels, and other dysplastic features (hypogranulation, pseudo-Pelger cells) discriminate.

ddx.dx: Apoptotic or degenerating neutrophil with nuclear fragmentation
ddx.vs: Apoptotic cells show dense, round, pyknotic fragments without connecting filaments, whereas these lobes retain normal chromatin texture and filamentous connections.

143.recognize_zh: HPLC 在 HbA2 window（滯留時間約 3.60 分）出現高達 87.5% 的單一巨峰、HbA0 僅 3.8%，鹼性電泳在 C/E/O/A2 位置有粗帶而無 HbA 帶，血片為小球性紅血球並有標靶細胞，符合同型合子 HbE 疾病。
features: Peripheral smear with small, relatively uniform red cells and scattered target cells; one polychromatic cell present
Many crenated (echinocytic) red cells across the field, most consistent with a preparation artifact
No sickle cells, spherocytes or nucleated red cells in this field
HPLC: single dominant peak in the A2 window (87.5%, RT 3.60 min), HbA0 3.8%, HbF 1.5%
Alkaline cellulose acetate electrophoresis: patient lane (arrow) with a single heavy band at the C/E/O/A2 position and no HbA band
Family HPLC: A2-window variant 27.5% with normal HbA0 (HbE trait) and HbA2 5.8% (beta-thalassemia trait)
143.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows red cells that are small with scattered target cells; numerous crenated cells are present and are likely a drying artifact, and no sickle cells or nucleated red cells are identified. Cation-exchange HPLC shows a single dominant variant peak in the HbA2 window (87.5%) with markedly reduced HbA0 (3.8%) and HbF 1.5%, and alkaline cellulose acetate electrophoresis shows a single band in the C/E/O/A2 region without HbA. The mother's HPLC shows an A2-window variant of 27.5% with normal HbA0 (HbE trait), and the husband's study shows HbA2 5.8% (beta-thalassemia trait). In a patient with normal iron studies, findings are consistent with homozygous HbE disease.

ddx.vs: HbE/beta0-thal also lacks HbA but has a substantially raised HbF (often 30-60%), more severe anemia and prominent poikilocytosis, whereas HbF here is only 1.5%.
HbE trait shows an A2-window variant of about 25-30% with abundant HbA0, as in the parental tracing, rather than >85% with near-absent HbA0.
These co-migrate with HbE on alkaline electrophoresis but elute in separate C- or later windows on HPLC, and HbC disease shows intracellular crystals.
Iron deficiency causes microcytosis with anisocytosis and pencil cells but a normal or low HbA2 and no variant peak, and iron studies here were normal.

captions: Peripheral blood smear: microcytes and target cells with crenation artifact
Patient HPLC: A2-window variant 87.5%, HbA0 3.8%, HbF 1.5%
Alkaline electrophoresis: patient lane (arrow) with C/E/O/A2 band and no HbA
Family HPLC: A2-window variant 27.5% (HbE trait)
Husband HPLC: HbA2 5.8% (beta-thalassemia trait)

79.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片被瀰漫片狀的中型細胞取代，核染色質細緻分散、核輪廓略不規則、可見小核仁，外觀像母細胞；周邊血可見類似的不典型淋巴細胞；B 細胞膜染色強陽性，而 cyclin D1 在腫瘤細胞為陰性（只有散在組織球/內皮細胞陽性作內部對照），核標記強陽性（符合 SOX11 型），指向 cyclin D1 陰性母細胞樣被套細胞淋巴瘤（blastoid mantle cell lymphoma）。
features: Bone marrow core: diffuse sheets of monotonous medium-sized to large lymphoid cells replacing normal hematopoiesis, with residual megakaryocytes
Blastoid cytology: round to slightly irregular or indented nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, small nucleoli and scant cytoplasm; frequent mitoses and apoptotic bodies
Peripheral blood: circulating atypical lymphoid cells with fine chromatin, irregular or cleaved nuclear contours and a thin rim of basophilic cytoplasm
IHC: strong diffuse membranous B-cell marker staining and strong cytoplasmic staining (BCL2-like pattern) in the infiltrate
Cyclin D1 IHC negative in tumor cells, with scattered positive internal-control histiocytes/endothelial cells
Strong diffuse nuclear staining in tumor cells (SOX11-like pattern) and a nuclear proliferation marker positive in a high proportion of cells with variable intensity
79.describe_en: Axial PET-CT shows splenomegaly with diffuse FDG uptake, FDG-avid upper abdominal/porta hepatis lymph nodes and increased vertebral marrow activity. The peripheral blood smear contains atypical medium-sized lymphoid cells with finely dispersed chromatin, irregular to cleaved nuclei and scant basophilic cytoplasm. The bone marrow biopsy is extensively replaced by sheets of monotonous blastoid lymphoid cells with fine chromatin, small nucleoli, slightly irregular nuclear contours and brisk mitotic and apoptotic activity. Immunohistochemistry shows strong membranous B-cell marker expression, a strong nuclear marker in nearly all tumor cells, cyclin D1 negativity in tumor cells with positive internal controls, and a high but variable proliferation index; individual antibodies other than cyclin D1 are not labeled in the figure. Findings are consistent with the blastoid variant of cyclin D1-negative mantle cell lymphoma, which requires SOX11 positivity and ideally demonstration of a CCND2/CCND3 rearrangement.

ddx.vs: B-ALL expresses TdT and CD34 with dim or absent surface immunoglobulin and CD20, whereas blastoid MCL is TdT-negative with bright surface light chain, CD20 and usually CD5 and SOX11.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma / high-grade B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are typically larger with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli and are usually CD5- and SOX11-negative, whereas blastoid MCL shows monotonous fine chromatin and SOX11 positivity with CCND1, CCND2 or CCND3 rearrangement.
Myeloblasts may look similar in marrow sections but express MPO, CD34, CD117 or CD33 and lack B-cell antigens, whereas this infiltrate is strongly positive for a B-cell membrane marker.
CLL/SLL is CD23-positive and SOX11-negative with dim surface light chain and clumped chromatin, whereas cyclin D1-negative MCL is usually CD23-negative and SOX11-positive.

79.stain: PET-CT; Wright-Giemsa; H&E; IHC incl. cyclin D1
captions: Axial PET-CT: splenomegaly with diffuse FDG uptake, avid upper abdominal lymph nodes and vertebral marrow uptake

15.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片幾乎全是各階段顆粒球系（明顯骨髓系優勢），有核紅血球前驅細胞極少，只偶見早期原紅血球（胞質深藍）；巨核細胞存在，流式也看不到 CD45 陰性/CD71 陽性的紅血球族群，這種單純紅血球系發育不良是 Diamond-Blackfan 貧血的表現。
features: BM aspirate: marked myeloid predominance with a full spectrum of granulocytic maturation (myeloblasts to segmented neutrophils)
Near absence of maturing erythroid precursors; only rare early erythroid precursors (pronormoblast-like cells with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and fine chromatin)
Megakaryocytes present with normal-appearing lobated nuclei; no dysplasia evident
Hemosiderin-laden macrophage with coarse blue-black granules (consistent with transfusional iron)
Occasional cells with condensed, fragmented nuclear material raising possible apoptosis
Flow: no distinct CD45-negative low-SSC erythroid cluster and virtually no CD71-positive events
15.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show a marked myeloid predominance, with granulocytic precursors at all stages of maturation and no significant dysplasia or increase in blasts. Erythroid precursors are strikingly reduced, with only rare early forms (pronormoblasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm) and a near absence of polychromatophilic and orthochromatic normoblasts; megakaryocytes are present. Hemosiderin-laden macrophages are seen, and occasional cells with fragmented condensed nuclei suggest apoptosis. Flow cytometry shows no CD45-negative erythroid population and virtually no CD71-positive events, supporting severe erythroid hypoplasia. In a transfusion-dependent young child with isolated anemia and an RPS19 mutation, findings are consistent with Diamond-Blackfan anemia.

ddx.vs: TEC also shows erythroid aplasia but occurs in older toddlers, is self-limited with normal MCV and HbF and normal erythrocyte adenosine deaminase, without ribosomal protein gene mutations.

ddx.dx: Parvovirus B19-associated pure red cell aplasia
ddx.vs: Parvovirus shows giant pronormoblasts with glassy intranuclear inclusions and positive B19 PCR, rather than the unremarkable rare early erythroid precursors seen here.

ddx.dx: Fanconi anemia and other inherited marrow failure
ddx.vs: Fanconi anemia typically causes multilineage cytopenias with global hypocellularity and positive chromosome breakage, whereas this marrow has isolated erythroid loss with preserved myeloid and megakaryocytic lines.
Pearson syndrome shows vacuolated erythroid and myeloid precursors with ring sideroblasts and mitochondrial DNA deletion, features not seen in these smears.

62415.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片中央是一個富含脂肪空泡的骨髓顆粒，周圍與背景充滿大量單一形態的小圓形淋巴樣細胞，箭頭標出散在、深紫黑色顆粒密集的肥大細胞；小淋巴球大量增加並伴隨肥大細胞增多，是淋巴漿細胞性淋巴瘤骨髓抹片的線索。
features: Marrow particle with abundant fat spaces and cellular rim
Background dominated by numerous small, round lymphoid cells with scant cytoplasm
Scattered mast cells with dense dark purple-black granules (arrows), increased in number
Relatively few recognizable erythroid and granulocytic precursors
Low magnification; plasmacytoid features and plasma cells not resolvable
62415.describe_en: Low-power bone marrow aspirate smear shows a fatty marrow particle surrounded by a cellular smear composed predominantly of small, round lymphoid cells with scant cytoplasm. Several mast cells with dense metachromatic granules are scattered near the particle and in the background (arrows), and erythroid and myeloid precursors are relatively sparse. Plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells cannot be resolved at this magnification. In the appropriate clinical context (IgM paraprotein, MYD88 L265P), the lymphocytosis with increased mast cells is consistent with marrow involvement by lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma.

ddx.vs: CLL cells are CD5/CD23-positive with smudge cells and lack a plasmacytic component, whereas LPL is typically CD5-/CD23- with plasmacytoid cells and IgM paraprotein.
MZL can show plasmacytic differentiation and mast cells, so separation relies on MYD88 L265P (frequent in LPL) and the clinical/nodal or splenic picture.
Systemic mastocytosis shows clusters of spindle-shaped, hypogranular CD25/CD2-positive mast cells rather than scattered round, well-granulated reactive mast cells among lymphocytes.
Hemodilution shows abundant red cells and mature neutrophils with few particles, rather than a lymphocyte-dominant particle-rich smear.

3599.recognize_zh: 大型白血球，核折疊呈腎形/分葉狀、染色質呈細網狀（lacy），胞質豐富灰藍色、含多個小空泡與細塵狀顆粒，細胞外緣不規則；這些都是成熟單核球的特徵。
features: Large cell, about two to three times the diameter of a red cell, with irregular cytoplasmic outline
Folded, reniform-to-lobulated nucleus
Fine, lacy (reticular) chromatin without nucleoli
Abundant gray-blue ('ground glass') cytoplasm
Multiple small cytoplasmic vacuoles and fine dust-like azurophilic granules
3599.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large leukocyte with an irregular cytoplasmic border, a folded reniform-to-lobulated nucleus with fine lacy chromatin, and abundant gray-blue cytoplasm containing several small vacuoles and fine dust-like granules. No nucleoli are seen. The surrounding red cells show rouleaux-like overlap consistent with a thick area of the smear. The morphology is that of a normal mature monocyte.

ddx.vs: Promonocytes have more delicately folded nuclei with visible nucleoli and more basophilic cytoplasm, and count as blast equivalents.
Reactive lymphocytes have more condensed chromatin and clear-to-basophilic cytoplasm scalloping around red cells, without vacuoles and fine granules.
Neutrophil precursors have pink secondary-granule cytoplasm and more clumped chromatin rather than gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm.

66255.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一顆遠大於周圍顆粒球的巨大細胞，單一多分葉、互相重疊的核，加上大量細緻紫紅色顆粒的胞質，這是成熟巨核細胞（megakaryocyte）的典型外觀；周圍可見嗜中性球與骨髓球作為大小對照。
features: Very large cell, many times the diameter of adjacent neutrophils
Single hyperlobated nucleus with overlapping, connected lobes and coarse chromatin
Abundant cytoplasm filled with fine azurophilic (purple) granules, consistent with a granular megakaryocyte
No discrete separate nuclei, distinguishing it from an osteoclast
Background of neutrophils, a myelocyte, a nucleated cell, and crenated red cells in a marrow aspirate
66255.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large megakaryocyte with a single, multilobated nucleus composed of overlapping lobes and abundant, finely granular pink-purple cytoplasm. Surrounding cells include segmented and band neutrophils, a granulocytic precursor, and an erythroid or lymphoid cell, providing a size reference. The megakaryocyte shows normal lobation without hypolobation, separated nuclear lobes, or small size. Findings represent a normal mature granular megakaryocyte.

ddx.vs: Osteoclasts contain multiple separate, uniform round nuclei rather than a single lobulated nucleus.
Dysplastic forms are small or hypolobated (micromegakaryocytes, mononuclear forms) or have widely separated nuclei, unlike this well-lobated cell.
Tumor cells and histiocytes lack the dense fine azurophilic granular cytoplasm and characteristic lobulated megakaryocytic nucleus.

2319.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中同時可見數顆大型芽細胞（細緻染色質、藍色胞質、高核質比）、一顆顆粒深紫而部分溶解的嗜鹼性球，以及一顆橘紅顆粒的嗜酸性球；芽細胞增加合併嗜鹼性球，是 CML 進入急變期的線索。
features: Three large blasts with high N:C ratio, fine open chromatin, and a rim of basophilic agranular cytoplasm
Basophil at upper left with dark purple, partially dissolved granules extending beyond the cell
Eosinophil at lower left with coarse orange-red granules
Segmented neutrophil adjacent to a blast and a small lymphoid-appearing cell
Red cells show mild anisocytosis without nucleated red cells in this field
2319.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several large blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, finely dispersed chromatin, and a thin rim of basophilic cytoplasm without evident Auer rods. A basophil with coarse, partially degranulated granules and an eosinophil are also present, together with a segmented neutrophil and a small lymphoid cell. Lineage of the blasts cannot be determined morphologically. In a patient with known BCR::ABL1-positive CML, findings are consistent with blast phase; flow cytometry is required to classify the blasts as myeloid or lymphoid.

ddx.vs: Chronic phase shows a full granulocytic maturation spectrum with a myelocyte peak and few blasts, rather than a prominent population of circulating blasts.

ddx.dx: De novo acute myeloid leukemia with BCR::ABL1
ddx.vs: De novo AML with BCR::ABL1 lacks a preceding chronic phase, splenomegaly, and basophilia, and the history is the main discriminator.
Ph+ B-ALL presents without basophilia or a CML background and often carries the p190 transcript rather than p210.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with basophilia (e.g., t(6;9))
ddx.vs: AML with DEK::NUP214 shows basophilia and dysplasia but is BCR::ABL1 negative.

62671.recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結被大量緊密排列（back-to-back）的濾泡取代，而且濾泡本身（生發中心）呈強陽性 BCL2 染色；反應性生發中心應為 BCL2 陰性，這是濾泡性淋巴瘤（follicular lymphoma）的關鍵線索。
features: Lymph node with effaced architecture by numerous closely packed, variably sized neoplastic follicles
Strong, uniform BCL2 staining throughout the follicles (germinal center compartment)
Follicles lack a distinct negative (BCL2-) germinal center with surrounding positive mantle
Interfollicular areas show weaker, scattered BCL2 positivity (background T cells)
Some follicles show irregular, serpiginous outlines with focal central pallor
62671.describe_en: Low-power view of a lymph node immunostained for BCL2 shows effacement of normal architecture by numerous closely packed follicles of varying size and irregular contour. The follicles show strong, diffuse BCL2 expression, which is more intense than that of the interfollicular T-cell–rich areas, and no BCL2-negative germinal centers are identified. Findings are consistent with nodal follicular lymphoma with aberrant BCL2 expression in follicle center cells.

ddx.vs: Reactive germinal centers are BCL2-negative with only scattered positive T cells, contain tingible-body macrophages, and show zonation and high polarized Ki-67.

ddx.dx: Nodal marginal zone lymphoma with follicular colonization
ddx.vs: MZL cells are BCL2+ but CD10/BCL6-negative and colonize residual germinal centers, which retain CD10+/BCL2- remnants.
MCL nodules are BCL2+ but cyclin D1/SOX11-positive and CD10/BCL6-negative.
